description.zh: 波多黎各 1897（基础版 3–5 人）的结构化规则定义。基于 Ravensburger 2022 年版规则书（doc/Puerto_Rico_1897_Rulebook.md），不含双人规则与扩展 I–IV。核心机制：每回合玩家从角色区选一张角色卡，选角者享特权、全员执行该角色的行动；种植园与建筑须有工人占据才生效；工人从工作登记册分发并按空半圆数补充。
description.en: Structured rule definition for Puerto Rico 1897 (base game, 3–5 players). Based on the Ravensburger 2022 rulebook (doc/Puerto_Rico_1897_Rulebook.md), excluding the two-player rules and Expansions I–IV. Core mechanics: each turn a player picks a role card; the chooser gets the privilege while everyone performs the role's action; estates and buildings only function when occupied by workers; workers are distributed from the Work Register, which is repopulated by the number of empty semicircles.

description.zh: 波多黎各中的货币资源。全游戏共 51 枚：43 枚 1 元银币 + 8 枚 5 元金币，开局全部放在<central_board>上的<bank>。钱币的来源：<trader_role>出售货物、<adventurer_role>、<factory>奖励、选到带钱的角色卡；用途：<builder_role>购买建筑、回合结束放在未被选的角色卡上。钱币必须放在<island_board>的<portrait>上且对所有玩家可见（公开信息）。
description.en: The currency resource in Puerto Rico. 51 coins total: 43 one-value silver coins + 8 five-value gold coins, all starting in the <bank> on the <central_board>. Coins come from: selling goods via <trader_role>, <adventurer_role>, <factory> rewards, and choosing a role card that has coins on it. They are spent on: buying buildings via <builder_role>, and the coins placed on unchosen role cards at round end. Coins must sit on the <portrait> of the <island_board> and remain visible to all players (public information).

description.zh: 钱币的计量单位。如「付 5 元买办公室」「得 2 元」。
description.en: Unit of currency. E.g., 'pay 5 to buy the Office', 'gain 2'.

appearance.zh: 圆形硬币：1 元为银色，5 元为金色，中央有面值数字。
appearance.en: Round coins: silver for value 1, gold for value 5, with the denomination printed in the center.

description.zh: 波多黎各中的胜利分数（VP）。游戏中获得的 VP 以筹码形式存在：1 分筹码 31 枚、5 分筹码 19 枚（合计 126 VP），按人数取用——3 人 75 VP、4 人 100 VP、5 人 126 VP，存放在<vp_supply>。VP 筹码放在<portrait>上，可背面朝上隐藏（VP 是游戏中唯一的隐藏信息）。VP 来源：<captain_role>装船（每桶 1 VP）、船长特权、<harbor>、<wharf>包租船。注意：终局计分中的建筑 VP 与大建筑加成是计算值，不是筹码。若筹码被拿完，用纸笔记录（触发终局条件之一）。
description.en: Victory points (VP) in Puerto Rico. VP gained during the game come as chips: 31 chips of 1 VP and 19 of 5 VP (126 VP total), used per player count — 75 VP for 3 players, 100 for 4, 126 for 5 — stored in <vp_supply>. VP chips sit on the <portrait> and may be placed face-down to conceal them (VP is the only hidden information in the game). Sources: shipping via <captain_role> (1 VP per barrel), the captain's privilege, <harbor>, and the <wharf> chartered ship. Note: building VP and large-building bonuses at final scoring are computed values, not chips. If the chips run out, track VP on paper (this triggers an endgame condition).

description.zh: VP 的计量单位。如「得 3 分」「每桶 1 分」。
description.en: Unit of VP. E.g., 'gain 3 VP', '1 VP per barrel'.

appearance.zh: 圆形小筹码：面值 1 或 5，颜色与图案按面值区分，可背面朝上放置在肖像上。
appearance.en: Small round chips with value 1 or 5, distinguished by color and design; may be placed face-down on the Portrait.

description.zh: 波多黎各中的劳动力资源。全游戏共 100 名：3 人局供应堆 55 名、4 人局 75 名、5 人局 95 名，开局先放「玩家数」名在<work_register>上，其余在<worker_supply>。工人的核心规则：<estate_tile>、<quarry_tile>与<building>板块上有 1–3 个半圆槽，每槽至多 1 名工人；板块上有至少 1 名工人即视为「被占据」，只有被占据的板块才生效。工人只能在<recruiter_role>阶段放置或移动；若岛上已无空槽，多余的工人放在<portrait>上，留待以后的招募阶段放置。
description.en: The labor resource in Puerto Rico. 100 workers total: 55 in the supply for 3 players, 75 for 4, 95 for 5; at setup, a number equal to the player count is placed on the <work_register> and the rest in <worker_supply>. Core rules: <estate_tile>s, <quarry_tile>s, and <building>s have 1–3 semicircle slots, at most 1 worker each; a tile with at least 1 worker is 'occupied', and only occupied tiles function. Workers may only be placed or moved during the <recruiter_role> phase; if no empty slot remains on the island board, surplus workers sit on the <portrait> until a future recruitment phase.

description.zh: 工人的计量单位。如「登记册上有 4 名工人」「得到 2 名工人」。
description.en: Unit of workers. E.g., '4 workers on the register', 'gain 2 workers'.

appearance.zh: 木质小人形指示物，形象为岛上农场中的男女老幼，颜色按玩家人数区分的原木色。
appearance.en: Wooden meeple-like tokens depicting the diverse people of the island's farms.

description.zh: 货物桶的外观描述——小木桶，颜色对应货物（黄=玉米、绿=水果、白=糖、棕=烟草、黑=咖啡）。AI 向玩家解释「哪个是咖啡桶」时的关键视觉信息。
description.en: Appearance of a goods barrel — a small wooden barrel colored by good (yellow=corn, green=fruit, white=sugar, brown=tobacco, black=coffee). Key visual info for the AI to identify barrels.

description.zh: 波多黎各中的货物资源，共五种：<corn>、<fruit>、<sugar>、<tobacco>、<coffee>，合计 50 桶（玉米 10、水果 11、糖 11、烟草 9、咖啡 9），开局全部按颜色摆在<goods_supply>。货物由<craftsman_role>阶段生产，放在<portrait>上（可无限堆放）；<trader_role>阶段可卖给<trading_house>换钱；<captain_role>阶段装船得 VP。装船后未装完的货物在阶段结束时要弃回<goods_supply>——每人最多保留 1 桶（有仓库可保留更多）。
description.en: Goods in Puerto Rico — five types: <corn>, <fruit>, <sugar>, <tobacco>, <coffee>; 50 barrels total (10 corn, 11 fruit, 11 sugar, 9 tobacco, 9 coffee), all sorted by color in <goods_supply> at setup. Goods are produced in the <craftsman_role> phase and stored on the <portrait> (unlimited stacking); they can be sold to the <trading_house> for coins in the <trader_role> phase, and shipped for VP in the <captain_role> phase. After shipping, unsold barrels must be forfeited to <goods_supply> at phase end — each player keeps at most 1 barrel (more with warehouses).

description.zh: 货物的计量单位。如「生产 3 桶糖」「卖掉 1 桶咖啡」。
description.en: Unit of goods. E.g., 'produce 3 sugar barrels', 'sell 1 coffee barrel'.

description.zh: 此货物在<trading_house>的售价（元）。印在交易所的对应位置上。
description.en: The sale price (coins) of this good at the <trading_house>, printed on the trading house.

description.zh: 每种货物都有固定售价——出售时按此价从<bank>取钱。
description.en: Every good has a fixed sale price — the seller takes that many coins from the <bank>.

description.zh: 黄色货物的<good>，售价 0 元。玉米是唯一不需要生产建筑的作物——每座被占据的<corn_estate>在生产阶段直接产出 1 桶玉米。玉米可以卖给交易所（哪怕 0 元，比如为了清空交易所或赚小市场加成），也可以装船得 VP。
description.en: The yellow <good>, sale price 0 coins. Corn is the only crop needing no production building — each occupied <corn_estate> directly produces 1 barrel in the production phase. Corn may be sold to the trading house (even for 0 coins — e.g., to empty the house or earn the Small Market bonus) or shipped for VP.

appearance.zh: 黄色小木桶。
appearance.en: Small yellow barrel.

description.zh: 绿色货物的<good>，售价 1 元。水果需要<fruit_estate>（有工人）+ 水果仓库类生产建筑（有工人）才能生产。
description.en: The green <good>, sale price 1 coin. Fruit requires an occupied <fruit_estate> plus an occupied fruit-warehouse production building to be produced.

appearance.zh: 绿色小木桶。
appearance.en: Small green barrel.

description.zh: 白色货物的<good>，售价 2 元。糖需要<sugar_estate>（有工人）+ 糖厂类生产建筑（有工人）才能生产。
description.en: The white <good>, sale price 2 coins. Sugar requires an occupied <sugar_estate> plus an occupied sugar-mill production building to be produced.

appearance.zh: 白色小木桶。
appearance.en: Small white barrel.

description.zh: 棕色货物的<good>，售价 3 元。烟草需要<tobacco_estate>（有工人）+ <tobacco_storage>（有工人）才能生产。
description.en: The brown <good>, sale price 3 coins. Tobacco requires an occupied <tobacco_estate> plus an occupied <tobacco_storage> to be produced.

appearance.zh: 棕色小木桶。
appearance.en: Small brown barrel.

description.zh: 黑色货物的<good>，售价 4 元。咖啡需要<coffee_estate>（有工人）+ <coffee_roaster>（有工人）才能生产。
description.en: The black <good>, sale price 4 coins. Coffee requires an occupied <coffee_estate> plus an occupied <coffee_roaster> to be produced.

appearance.zh: 黑色小木桶。
appearance.en: Small black barrel.

description.zh: 庄园板块的外观描述——方形小板块，正面画作物图案与 1 个工人半圆槽，背面统一图案。
description.en: Appearance of an estate tile — a small square tile with the crop art and 1 worker semicircle on the front, uniform back.

description.zh: 波多黎各中的种植园板块——一种<ontology::tile>，共 50 块：<fruit_estate> 12、<sugar_estate> 11、<corn_estate> 10、<tobacco_estate> 9、<coffee_estate> 8。庄园放在<island_board>的<countryside>（12 格）中。来源：开局按座次发 1 块（明置）；<planter_role>阶段从<estate_display>取明置庄园、或用<builders_yard>/庄园特权额外获取。每块庄园有 1 个半圆槽，放工人即被占据；被占据的庄园参与生产——玉米庄园直接产玉米，其余庄园须有对应生产建筑的工人才产货。庄园一旦放置不可移出岛屿版图（可在 12 格内挪位置）。
description.en: Plantation tiles in Puerto Rico — a type of <ontology::tile>, 50 in total: 12 <fruit_estate>, 11 <sugar_estate>, 10 <corn_estate>, 9 <tobacco_estate>, 8 <coffee_estate>. Estates are placed in the <countryside> (12 spaces) of the <island_board>. Sources: 1 face-up tile per player at setup (by seating order); face-up tiles from the <estate_display> during the <planter_role> phase, plus extras via <builders_yard> or the Hacienda privilege. Each estate has 1 semicircle slot; a worker on it makes it occupied. Occupied estates produce — corn estates produce corn directly; other estates need matching workers in their production building. Once placed, an estate may not leave the island board (it can be rearranged within the 12 spaces).

description.zh: 半圆槽数量，固定为 1。每块庄园至多 1 名工人。
description.en: Number of semicircle slots, fixed at 1. At most 1 worker per estate.

description.zh: 此庄园种植的作物类型。决定生产阶段产出哪种<good>。
description.en: The crop type of this estate, determining which <good> it produces in the production phase.

description.zh: 此类型庄园在游戏中的份数。
description.en: Number of copies of this estate type in the game.

description.zh: 每块庄园必有所属作物。
description.en: Every estate belongs to a crop type.

appearance.zh: 黄色玉米田图案的庄园小板块，带 1 个半圆槽。
appearance.en: Small estate tile with yellow cornfield art and 1 semicircle.

description.zh: 种植玉米的<estate_tile>，共 10 块。被占据时在<craftsman_role>阶段直接产出 1 桶<corn>——玉米是唯一不需要生产建筑的作物。
description.en: A <estate_tile> growing corn, 10 copies. When occupied, it directly produces 1 <corn> barrel in the <craftsman_role> phase — corn is the only crop that needs no production building.

appearance.zh: 绿色果园图案的庄园小板块，带 1 个半圆槽。
appearance.en: Small estate tile with green orchard art and 1 semicircle.

description.zh: 种植水果的<estate_tile>，共 12 块。被占据且<small_fruit_warehouse>/<large_fruit_warehouse>中有工人时，在<craftsman_role>阶段产出<fruit>。
description.en: A <estate_tile> growing fruit, 12 copies. When occupied and with a worker in a <small_fruit_warehouse> or <large_fruit_warehouse>, it produces <fruit> in the <craftsman_role> phase.

appearance.zh: 白色甘蔗田图案的庄园小板块，带 1 个半圆槽。
appearance.en: Small estate tile with white sugarcane art and 1 semicircle.

description.zh: 种植甘蔗的<estate_tile>，共 11 块。被占据且<small_sugar_mill>/<large_sugar_mill>中有工人时，在<craftsman_role>阶段产出<sugar>。
description.en: A <estate_tile> growing sugarcane, 11 copies. When occupied and with a worker in a <small_sugar_mill> or <large_sugar_mill>, it produces <sugar> in the <craftsman_role> phase.

appearance.zh: 棕色烟叶田图案的庄园小板块，带 1 个半圆槽。
appearance.en: Small estate tile with brown tobacco-field art and 1 semicircle.

description.zh: 种植烟草的<estate_tile>，共 9 块。被占据且<tobacco_storage>中有工人时，在<craftsman_role>阶段产出<tobacco>。
description.en: A <estate_tile> growing tobacco, 9 copies. When occupied and with a worker in the <tobacco_storage>, it produces <tobacco> in the <craftsman_role> phase.

appearance.zh: 黑色咖啡园图案的庄园小板块，带 1 个半圆槽。
appearance.en: Small estate tile with black coffee-plantation art and 1 semicircle.

description.zh: 种植咖啡的<estate_tile>，共 8 块。被占据且<coffee_roaster>中有工人时，在<craftsman_role>阶段产出<coffee>。
description.en: A <estate_tile> growing coffee, 8 copies. When occupied and with a worker in the <coffee_roaster>, it produces <coffee> in the <craftsman_role> phase.

appearance.zh: 灰色采石场图案的小板块，带 1 个半圆槽。
appearance.en: Small tile with gray quarry art and 1 semicircle.

description.zh: 波多黎各中的采石场板块——一种<ontology::tile>，共 8 块，开局全部明置叠在<quarry_stack>。采石场放在<island_board>的<countryside>中，有 1 个半圆槽。被占据的采石场在<builder_role>阶段提供建筑费折扣：每座被占据的采石场减 1 元，但减免上限由建筑所在区块决定（顶层 1 座、第二层 2 座、第三层 3 座、大建筑 4 座）。获取方式：<planter_role>的特权（选角者），或非选角者拥有被占据的<builders_yard>。若采石场被拿完，种植园主失去特权、建筑工棚无法使用。
description.en: Quarry tiles in Puerto Rico — a type of <ontology::tile>, 8 copies, all face-up in a stack on the <quarry_stack> at setup. Quarries go into the <countryside> of the <island_board> and have 1 semicircle slot. An occupied quarry gives a building-cost discount in the <builder_role> phase: −1 coin per occupied quarry, capped by the building's board section (top: 1, second: 2, third: 3, large buildings: 4). Acquisition: the <planter_role> privilege (for the chooser), or a non-chooser with an occupied <builders_yard>. When quarries run out, the planter loses the privilege and the builders yard is unusable.

description.zh: 半圆槽数量，固定为 1。每块采石场至多 1 名工人。
description.en: Number of semicircle slots, fixed at 1. At most 1 worker per quarry.

description.zh: 采石场份数，固定为 8。
description.en: Number of quarries, fixed at 8.

description.zh: 采石场折扣——光环类效果。只要本采石场被占据（active_condition），该玩家购买建筑的费用减 1 元，每座被占据的采石场各减 1 元；总减免上限由目标建筑所在区块决定（见<building>的 board_section 与 max_quarry_discount）。参与计算的效果——购买费用查询时现算，采石场上的工人被移走则减免随之消失。
description.en: Quarry discount — an aura effect. As long as this quarry is occupied (active_condition), the player pays 1 coin less per building, stacking −1 per occupied quarry; the total discount is capped by the target building's board section (see board_section and max_quarry_discount on <building>). It participates in computation — the purchase cost is computed on query, and the discount disappears if the worker leaves the quarry.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本采石场被占据（半圆槽上有工人）。
<ontology::condition>.en: This quarry is occupied (a worker is on its semicircle).

description.zh: 建筑板块的外观描述——正面印建筑名、右上角 VP 数字、半圆槽（首个半圆内印费用）、功能图标（商业建筑），背面统一图案。
description.en: Appearance of a building tile — front shows the name, the VP number top-right, semicircles (the first one printed with the cost), and the function icon (commercial buildings); uniform back.

description.zh: 波多黎各中的建筑板块——一种<ontology::tile>，共 49 座，开局全部按类型堆叠在<central_board>的对应位置上（<building_supply>）。建筑放在<island_board>的<city>（12 格）中。通用规则：每名玩家每种建筑至多建 1 座；只有被占据（半圆槽上有工人）的建筑才能使用特殊功能；建筑上的 VP 数字无论是否被占据都在终局计分；板块左下角第一个半圆内的数字是费用，建成后可忽略。建筑按区块分四层（顶层费用 1–2、第二层 3–5、第三层 6–9、底层大建筑 10），区块决定采石场折扣上限。三种建筑：<production_building>（生产货物）、<commercial_building>（特殊功能）、<large_commercial_building>（占 2 格、终局加成）。
description.en: Building tiles in Puerto Rico — a type of <ontology::tile>, 49 total, all stacked by type on their spaces on the <central_board> (<building_supply>) at setup. Buildings are placed in the <city> (12 spaces) of the <island_board>. General rules: each player may build each building type at most once; only occupied buildings (a worker on a semicircle) may use their special function; the VP number on a building scores at game end whether occupied or not; the number in the first semicircle is the cost, ignorable after building. Buildings sit in four board sections (top: cost 1–2; second: 3–5; third: 6–9; bottom: large buildings at 10), which cap the quarry discount. Three kinds: <production_building> (produce goods), <commercial_building> (special functions), <large_commercial_building> (take 2 spaces, endgame bonuses).

description.zh: 建筑费用（元）。<builder_role>阶段支付：基础费用 − 采石场折扣（≤ 区块上限）− 选角者特权 1 元。
description.en: Building cost (coins). Paid in the <builder_role> phase: base cost − quarry discount (≤ section cap) − 1 for the chooser's privilege.

description.zh: 建筑提供的 VP（右上角数字）。终局计分时计入，无论是否被占据。
description.en: The VP of this building (top-right number). Scored at game end, whether occupied or not.

description.zh: 建筑上的半圆槽数量（1–3），即最多可容纳的工人数，也参与<work_register>补充时的空槽计数。
description.en: Number of semicircle slots (1–3) on this building — its worker capacity, also counted when repopulating the <work_register>.

description.zh: 建筑在中央版图上所在的区块：top=顶层（费用 1–2）、second=第二层（费用 3–5）、third=第三层（费用 6–9）、bottom=底层大建筑（费用 10）。决定采石场折扣上限。
description.en: The board section where this building sits: top (cost 1–2), second (cost 3–5), third (cost 6–9), bottom (large buildings, cost 10). Determines the quarry discount cap.

description.zh: 此建筑可享受的采石场折扣上限：top=1、second=2、third=3、bottom=4。
description.en: The maximum quarry discount for this building: top=1, second=2, third=3, bottom=4.

description.zh: 建筑占用的<city>格数。普通建筑 1 格；大建筑 2 格（需 2 个相邻空格）。
description.en: Number of <city> spaces this building occupies. Normal buildings take 1; large buildings take 2 (requiring 2 adjacent empty spaces).

description.zh: 此建筑类型在游戏中的份数。份数用完后不能再建。
description.en: Number of copies of this building type in the game. When exhausted, it can no longer be built.

description.zh: 每座建筑都有费用——购买时支付。
description.en: Every building has a cost paid on purchase.

description.zh: 每座建筑都提供 VP——终局计分。
description.en: Every building provides VP for final scoring.

description.zh: 每座建筑都属于中央版图的某个区块——决定采石场折扣上限。
description.en: Every building belongs to a board section, which caps the quarry discount.

description.zh: 每座建筑的采石场折扣上限由其区块决定。
description.en: Each building's quarry discount cap is set by its section.

description.zh: 生产建筑板块的外观——板块颜色对应产物：绿=水果、白=糖、棕=烟草、黑=咖啡。
description.en: Appearance of a production building tile — color-coded by product: green=fruit, white=sugar, brown=tobacco, black=coffee.

description.zh: 在<craftsman_role>阶段生产货物的<building>，共 20 座（6 种）。生产规则：每种货物（除<corn>）的生产量 = min(该作物被占据的<estate_tile>数, 该作物所有生产建筑上被占据的半圆槽数)——庄园和生产建筑都要有工人，缺一不可。玉米不需要生产建筑。生产建筑的半圆槽数即最大产量（<small_fruit_warehouse>/<small_sugar_mill> 1、<large_fruit_warehouse>/<large_sugar_mill> 2、<tobacco_storage>/<coffee_roaster> 3）。
description.en: A <building> that produces goods in the <craftsman_role> phase — 20 buildings of 6 types. Production rule: for each good (except <corn>), production = min(occupied <estate_tile>s of that crop, occupied semicircles across that crop's production buildings) — both the estates and the building must be occupied. Corn needs no production building. A production building's semicircle count is its maximum output (<small_fruit_warehouse>/<small_sugar_mill> 1, <large_fruit_warehouse>/<large_sugar_mill> 2, <tobacco_storage>/<coffee_roaster> 3).

description.zh: 此建筑生产的货物类型。
description.en: The <good> type this building produces.

description.zh: 每座生产建筑必对应一种货物。
description.en: Every production building maps to one good type.

appearance.zh: 绿色图案的生产建筑小板块，1 个半圆槽，费用 1、1 VP。
appearance.en: Small green production building tile, 1 semicircle, cost 1, 1 VP.

description.zh: 费用 1 元、1 VP、1 个半圆槽的<production_building>，共 2 座。被占据时最多产 1 桶<fruit>。
description.en: A <production_building> costing 1, worth 1 VP, with 1 semicircle; 2 copies. Produces up to 1 <fruit> barrel when occupied.

appearance.zh: 白色图案的生产建筑小板块，1 个半圆槽，费用 2、1 VP。
appearance.en: Small white production building tile, 1 semicircle, cost 2, 1 VP.

description.zh: 费用 2 元、1 VP、1 个半圆槽的<production_building>，共 2 座。被占据时最多产 1 桶<sugar>。
description.en: A <production_building> costing 2, worth 1 VP, with 1 semicircle; 2 copies. Produces up to 1 <sugar> barrel when occupied.

appearance.zh: 绿色图案的生产建筑板块，2 个半圆槽，费用 3、2 VP。
appearance.en: Green production building tile, 2 semicircles, cost 3, 2 VP.

description.zh: 费用 3 元、2 VP、2 个半圆槽的<production_building>，共 4 座。被占据时最多产 2 桶<fruit>。
description.en: A <production_building> costing 3, worth 2 VP, with 2 semicircles; 4 copies. Produces up to 2 <fruit> barrels when occupied.

appearance.zh: 白色图案的生产建筑板块，2 个半圆槽，费用 4、2 VP。
appearance.en: White production building tile, 2 semicircles, cost 4, 2 VP.

description.zh: 费用 4 元、2 VP、2 个半圆槽的<production_building>，共 4 座。被占据时最多产 2 桶<sugar>。
description.en: A <production_building> costing 4, worth 2 VP, with 2 semicircles; 4 copies. Produces up to 2 <sugar> barrels when occupied.

appearance.zh: 棕色图案的生产建筑板块，3 个半圆槽，费用 5、3 VP。
appearance.en: Brown production building tile, 3 semicircles, cost 5, 3 VP.

description.zh: 费用 5 元、3 VP、3 个半圆槽的<production_building>，共 4 座。被占据时最多产 3 桶<tobacco>。
description.en: A <production_building> costing 5, worth 3 VP, with 3 semicircles; 4 copies. Produces up to 3 <tobacco> barrels when occupied.

appearance.zh: 黑色图案的生产建筑板块，3 个半圆槽，费用 6、3 VP。
appearance.en: Black production building tile, 3 semicircles, cost 6, 3 VP.

description.zh: 费用 6 元、3 VP、3 个半圆槽的<production_building>，共 4 座。被占据时最多产 3 桶<coffee>。
description.en: A <production_building> costing 6, worth 3 VP, with 3 semicircles; 4 copies. Produces up to 3 <coffee> barrels when occupied.

description.zh: 商业建筑板块的外观——印建筑名、费用、VP 与功能图标（板块名称下方的图标标明生效阶段）。
description.en: Appearance of a commercial building tile — shows the name, cost, VP, and a function icon (the icon under the name marks the phase it applies in).

description.zh: 拥有特殊功能的<building>，共 24 座（12 种、每种 2 份）。功能只在使用特定角色阶段时触发（板块名称下方的图标标明），且只有被占据才可用。功能可选用——尤其是<wharf>（每个装运阶段至多 1 次）。
description.en: A <building> with a special function — 24 buildings (12 types, 2 copies each). A function only applies during a specific role phase (shown by the icon under the building's name) and only when occupied. Functions are optional — notably the <wharf> (at most once per shipment phase).

description.zh: 每种商业建筑各 2 份。
description.en: 2 copies of each commercial building type.

appearance.zh: 紫色调商业建筑小板块，费用 1、1 VP，标贸易阶段图标。
appearance.en: Small purple commercial building tile, cost 1, 1 VP, marked with the trade-phase icon.

description.zh: 费用 1 元、1 VP 的<commercial_building>。功能：<trader_role>阶段出售货物时多得 1 元（与<large_market>叠加共 3 元，与<trader_role>特权再叠加）。例：卖 1 桶<corn>（0 元）得 1 元。
description.en: A <commercial_building> costing 1, worth 1 VP. Function: +1 coin when selling a good in the <trader_role> phase (stacks with <large_market> to +3, and further with the <trader_role> privilege). Example: selling 1 <corn> barrel (0 coins) earns 1 coin.

description.zh: 监听式效果：每次自己在<trader_role>阶段成功出售货物，多得 1 元。
description.en: Monitor effect: each time you sell a good in the <trader_role> phase, gain 1 extra coin.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本建筑被占据，且自己在本<trader_role>阶段向<trading_house>出售了 1 桶货物。
<ontology::condition>.en: This building is occupied and you sold a barrel to the <trading_house> in this <trader_role> phase.

appearance.zh: 紫色调商业建筑小板块，费用 2、1 VP，标种植阶段图标。
appearance.en: Small purple commercial building tile, cost 2, 1 VP, marked with the planting-phase icon.

description.zh: 费用 2 元、1 VP 的<commercial_building>。功能：<planter_role>阶段，在自己正常种植行动之前，可从<estate_face_down_stack>顶额外抽 1 块庄园，抽到后必须立即放到自己的<countryside>（不能丢弃），然后再正常从<estate_display>取明置庄园。注意：若同时有<builders_yard>，这额外的一块不能用采石场替代，但正常行动可以选采石场。
description.en: A <commercial_building> costing 2, worth 1 VP. Function: in the <planter_role> phase, before your normal planting action, you may draw 1 extra estate from the top of the <estate_face_down_stack> and must immediately place it in your <countryside> (cannot be discarded); then you take your normal face-up estate from the <estate_display>. Note: with a <builders_yard> too, this extra tile cannot be a quarry, but the normal action may still take one.

description.zh: 可选效果：<planter_role>阶段自己正常种植前，从<estate_face_down_stack>顶抽 1 块庄园并立即放到<countryside>。
description.en: Optional effect: before your normal planting in the <planter_role> phase, draw 1 estate from the top of the <estate_face_down_stack> and place it in the <countryside> immediately.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本建筑被占据，且自己即将在<planter_role>阶段进行种植行动。
<ontology::condition>.en: This building is occupied and you are about to perform your planting action in the <planter_role> phase.

appearance.zh: 紫色调商业建筑小板块，费用 2、1 VP，标种植阶段图标。
appearance.en: Small purple commercial building tile, cost 2, 1 VP, marked with the planting-phase icon.

description.zh: 费用 2 元、1 VP 的<commercial_building>。功能：<planter_role>阶段，非选角者可用采石场代替庄园。注意：此功能不提供第二块采石场——若自己是选角者（特权已可拿采石场），或用<hacienda>功能时，不能借它额外再拿一块采石场。
description.en: A <commercial_building> costing 2, worth 1 VP. Function: in the <planter_role> phase, a non-chooser may take a quarry instead of an estate. Note: this grants no second quarry — if you are the chooser (whose privilege already allows a quarry), or when using the <hacienda> function, you cannot take an additional quarry via the yard.

description.zh: 光环类效果：只要本建筑被占据，自己在<planter_role>阶段（非选角者时）种植行动的候选中增加「拿采石场」。
description.en: Aura effect: while this building is occupied, 'take a quarry' is added to your planting candidates in the <planter_role> phase (as a non-chooser).

appearance.zh: 紫色调商业建筑小板块，费用 3、1 VP，标装运阶段图标。
appearance.en: Small purple commercial building tile, cost 3, 1 VP, marked with the shipment-phase icon.

description.zh: 费用 3 元、1 VP 的<commercial_building>。功能：<captain_role>阶段结束时，除每人可保留的 1 桶外，可额外保留 1 种货物的全部桶（货物留在<portrait>上）。注意：装船义务不变——装运阶段中能装的货仍必须装。
description.en: A <commercial_building> costing 3, worth 1 VP. Function: at the end of the <captain_role> phase, in addition to the 1 barrel everyone keeps, you may keep all barrels of 1 more type (stored on the <portrait>). Note: the shipping obligation is unchanged — you must still load whatever you can during the phase.

description.zh: 监听式效果：每次<captain_role>阶段结束的留存结算时，自己可额外保留 1 种货物的全部桶。
description.en: Monitor effect: at each end-of-phase storage resolution in the <captain_role> phase, you may keep all barrels of 1 additional type.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本建筑被占据，且自己正进行<captain_role>阶段结束时的货物留存。
<ontology::condition>.en: This building is occupied and you are resolving end-of-phase goods storage in the <captain_role> phase.

appearance.zh: 紫色调商业建筑板块，费用 4、2 VP，标种植阶段图标。
appearance.en: Purple commercial building tile, cost 4, 2 VP, marked with the planting-phase icon.

description.zh: 费用 4 元、2 VP 的<commercial_building>。功能：<planter_role>阶段，若自己在<countryside>放置了庄园或采石场，可从<worker_supply>（不是<work_register>）拿 1 名工人放在刚放置的那块板块上（不能放别处）；<worker_supply>为空时可改从<work_register>拿。若同时有<hacienda>（本阶段放了两块），可选其中一块放工人，但只拿 1 名。
description.en: A <commercial_building> costing 4, worth 2 VP. Function: in the <planter_role> phase, if you placed an estate or quarry in your <countryside>, you may take 1 worker from the <worker_supply> (not the <work_register>) and place it on the newly placed tile (nowhere else); if the <worker_supply> is empty, take from the <work_register> instead. With a <hacienda> too (two tiles placed this phase), choose one of them for the worker, but take only 1 worker.

description.zh: 监听式效果：每次自己在<planter_role>阶段放置庄园/采石场，可拿 1 名工人放在该板块上（<worker_supply>优先，空则<work_register>）。
description.en: Monitor effect: each time you place an estate or quarry in the <planter_role> phase, you may take 1 worker onto that tile (from <worker_supply> first, or the <work_register> if empty).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本建筑被占据，且自己刚在<planter_role>阶段放置了庄园或采石场。
<ontology::condition>.en: This building is occupied and you just placed an estate or quarry in the <planter_role> phase.

destination.zh: 刚放置的那块庄园或采石场（半圆槽）。
destination.en: The semicircle of the tile just placed.

appearance.zh: 紫色调商业建筑板块，费用 5、2 VP，标贸易阶段图标。
appearance.en: Purple commercial building tile, cost 5, 2 VP, marked with the trade-phase icon.

description.zh: 费用 5 元、2 VP 的<commercial_building>。功能：<trader_role>阶段可出售<trading_house>里已有的货物类型（正常情况下每种类型一阶段只能卖 1 桶）。仍只能卖 1 桶；若交易所已满（4 桶）仍不能卖。多个有办公室的玩家可先后出售同一类型——只要还有空位。
description.en: A <commercial_building> costing 5, worth 2 VP. Function: in the <trader_role> phase, you may sell a good type already present in the <trading_house> (normally each type sells at most once per phase). You still sell only 1 barrel; a full house (4 barrels) still blocks the sale. Multiple Office owners may each sell the same type in one phase — space permitting.

description.zh: 光环类效果：只要本建筑被占据，自己在<trader_role>阶段出售货物的条件放宽——可出售交易所里已有的类型（交易所满 4 桶时仍不可）。
description.en: Aura effect: while this building is occupied, your sale condition in the <trader_role> phase is relaxed — you may sell a type already in the house (still blocked when the house is full at 4 barrels).

appearance.zh: 紫色调商业建筑板块，费用 5、2 VP，标贸易阶段图标。
appearance.en: Purple commercial building tile, cost 5, 2 VP, marked with the trade-phase icon.

description.zh: 费用 5 元、2 VP 的<commercial_building>。功能：<trader_role>阶段出售货物时多得 2 元；若同时有<small_market>，共多得 3 元。
description.en: A <commercial_building> costing 5, worth 2 VP. Function: +2 coins when selling a good in the <trader_role> phase; with a <small_market> too, +3 coins in total.

description.zh: 监听式效果：每次自己在<trader_role>阶段成功出售货物，多得 2 元（与<small_market>叠加）。
description.en: Monitor effect: each time you sell a good in the <trader_role> phase, gain 2 extra coins (stacking with <small_market>).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本建筑被占据，且自己在本<trader_role>阶段向<trading_house>出售了 1 桶货物。
<ontology::condition>.en: This building is occupied and you sold a barrel to the <trading_house> in this <trader_role> phase.

appearance.zh: 紫色调商业建筑板块，费用 6、2 VP，标装运阶段图标。
appearance.en: Purple commercial building tile, cost 6, 2 VP, marked with the shipment-phase icon.

description.zh: 费用 6 元、2 VP 的<commercial_building>。功能：<captain_role>阶段结束时，除每人可保留的 1 桶外，可额外保留 2 种货物的全部桶；若同时有<small_warehouse>，共可额外保留 3 种。货物留在<portrait>上。装船义务不变。
description.en: A <commercial_building> costing 6, worth 2 VP. Function: at the end of the <captain_role> phase, in addition to the 1 barrel everyone keeps, you may keep all barrels of 2 more types; with a <small_warehouse> too, 3 more types. Barrels stay on the <portrait>. The shipping obligation is unchanged.

description.zh: 监听式效果：每次<captain_role>阶段结束的留存结算时，自己可额外保留 2 种货物的全部桶（有<small_warehouse>则 3 种）。
description.en: Monitor effect: at each end-of-phase storage resolution in the <captain_role> phase, you may keep all barrels of 2 additional types (3 with a <small_warehouse>).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本建筑被占据，且自己正进行<captain_role>阶段结束时的货物留存。
<ontology::condition>.en: This building is occupied and you are resolving end-of-phase goods storage in the <captain_role> phase.

appearance.zh: 紫色调商业建筑板块，费用 7、3 VP，标生产阶段图标。
appearance.en: Purple commercial building tile, cost 7, 3 VP, marked with the production-phase icon.

description.zh: 费用 7 元、3 VP 的<commercial_building>。功能：<craftsman_role>阶段，若自己生产的货物种类超过 1 种，从<bank>得钱（与桶数无关）：2 种 1 元、3 种 2 元、4 种 3 元、5 种 5 元。
description.en: A <commercial_building> costing 7, worth 3 VP. Function: in the <craftsman_role> phase, if you produce more than 1 type of good, take coins from the <bank> regardless of barrel counts: 2 types → 1 coin, 3 → 2, 4 → 3, 5 → 5.

description.zh: 监听式效果：每次自己在<craftsman_role>阶段产出 ≥2 种货物，按种类数得钱（2 种 1 元、3 种 2 元、4 种 3 元、5 种 5 元）。
description.en: Monitor effect: each time you produce ≥2 types of goods in the <craftsman_role> phase, gain coins by type count (2→1, 3→2, 4→3, 5→5).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本建筑被占据，且自己在本<craftsman_role>阶段生产了超过 1 种货物。
<ontology::condition>.en: This building is occupied and you produced more than 1 type of good in this <craftsman_role> phase.

quantity.zh: 按生产货物种类数：2 种 1 元、3 种 2 元、4 种 3 元、5 种 5 元。
quantity.en: By number of produced types: 2→1, 3→2, 4→3, 5→5.

appearance.zh: 紫色调商业建筑板块，费用 8、3 VP，标建造阶段图标。
appearance.en: Purple commercial building tile, cost 8, 3 VP, marked with the build-phase icon.

description.zh: 费用 8 元、3 VP 的<commercial_building>。功能：<builder_role>阶段，若自己建造了建筑，可从<worker_supply>（不是<work_register>）拿 1 名工人放在刚建好的建筑上（不能放别处）；<worker_supply>为空时可改从<work_register>拿。即使建筑有多个半圆槽，也只拿 1 名工人。
description.en: A <commercial_building> costing 8, worth 3 VP. Function: in the <builder_role> phase, if you build a building, you may take 1 worker from the <worker_supply> (not the <work_register>) and place it on the newly built tile (nowhere else); if the <worker_supply> is empty, take from the <work_register> instead. Only 1 worker, even if the building has several semicircles.

description.zh: 监听式效果：每次自己在<builder_role>阶段建成建筑，可拿 1 名工人放在该建筑上（<worker_supply>优先，空则<work_register>）。
description.en: Monitor effect: each time you build in the <builder_role> phase, you may take 1 worker onto that building (from <worker_supply> first, or the <work_register> if empty).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本建筑被占据，且自己刚在<builder_role>阶段建造了建筑。
<ontology::condition>.en: This building is occupied and you just built a building in the <builder_role> phase.

destination.en: A semicircle of the newly built building.

appearance.zh: 紫色调商业建筑板块，费用 8、3 VP，标装运阶段图标。
appearance.en: Purple commercial building tile, cost 8, 3 VP, marked with the shipment-phase icon.

quantity.zh: 每次装货 +1 VP
quantity.en: +1 VP per load

description.zh: 费用 8 元、3 VP 的<commercial_building>。功能：<captain_role>阶段，自己每次往船上装货（含<wharf>的包租船）多得 1 VP——按「装货次数」而非桶数计。例：一次装 3 桶得 3+1 VP，之后同阶段再装 2 桶又得 2+1 VP。
description.en: A <commercial_building> costing 8, worth 3 VP. Function: in the <captain_role> phase, +1 VP each time you load goods onto a ship (including the <wharf> chartered ship) — counted per load, not per barrel. Example: loading 3 barrels earns 3+1 VP; loading 2 more later in the same phase earns 2+1 VP.

description.zh: 监听式效果：每次自己在<captain_role>阶段完成一次装货（普通货船或包租船），多得 1 VP。
description.en: Monitor effect: each time you complete a load in the <captain_role> phase (cargo ship or chartered ship), gain 1 extra VP.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本建筑被占据，且自己刚在<captain_role>阶段装了一次货。
<ontology::condition>.en: This building is occupied and you just completed a load in the <captain_role> phase.

appearance.zh: 紫色调商业建筑板块，费用 9、3 VP，标装运阶段图标。
appearance.en: Purple commercial building tile, cost 9, 3 VP, marked with the shipment-phase icon.

description.zh: 费用 9 元、3 VP 的<commercial_building>。功能：<captain_role>阶段内任意时刻（若使用），可把任意 1 种货物的全部桶装上「包租船」——包租船没有容量限制、可装货船上已有的类型，每桶得 1 VP，装完后桶全部放回<goods_supply>。每阶段至多使用 1 次，可不用。用它装货同样履行该轮装货义务：轮到自己装货时，装普通船或码头包租船必选其一（不能两者都不装）；可以先包租再装普通船，顺序自由。
description.en: A <commercial_building> costing 9, worth 3 VP. Function: at any one time during the <captain_role> phase (if used at all), you may load all barrels of any 1 type onto a 'Chartered Ship' — unlimited capacity, may carry a type already on a cargo ship, 1 VP per barrel, then all barrels return to the <goods_supply>. At most once per phase; may be skipped. Using it equally satisfies that round's loading obligation: on your loading turn you must choose one — cargo ship or chartered ship (doing neither is not allowed); you may charter before loading cargo ships, in either order.

description.zh: 监听式效果：<captain_role>阶段中可触发一次——把任意 1 种货物的全部桶装包租船：桶回<goods_supply>，每桶得 1 VP。
description.en: Monitor effect: usable once per <captain_role> phase — load all barrels of any 1 type onto the chartered ship: barrels return to <goods_supply>, 1 VP per barrel.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本建筑被占据，正处于<captain_role>阶段，且本阶段尚未使用过包租船。
<ontology::condition>.en: This building is occupied, we are in the <captain_role> phase, and the chartered ship has not been used this phase.

quantity.zh: 自己所选 1 种货物的全部桶。
quantity.en: All barrels of the chosen type.

quantity.zh: 等于装包的桶数（每桶 1 分）。
quantity.en: Equal to the number of barrels loaded (1 VP each).

description.zh: 大商业建筑板块的外观——两格高的宽板块，紫色调，印建筑名、费用 10、VP 4 与终局加成说明。
description.en: Appearance of a large commercial building tile — a double-height wide purple tile showing the name, cost 10, VP 4, and the endgame bonus.

description.zh: 占 2 个<city>格（需 2 个相邻空格）的<building>，共 5 种、每种 1 份，费用均为 10 元。大建筑本身提供 4 VP——即使未被占据也计 4 VP；但只有被占据时才有额外加成（终局计分）。
description.en: A <building> taking 2 <city> spaces (requiring 2 adjacent empty spaces) — 5 types, 1 copy each, all costing 10. Each large building is worth 4 VP — counted even when unoccupied; the bonus VP apply only when occupied, at final scoring.

description.zh: 大建筑费用，固定为 10 元。
description.en: Large building cost, fixed at 10.

description.zh: 大建筑占 2 个城市格。
description.en: Large buildings occupy 2 city spaces.

description.zh: 每种大建筑仅 1 份。
description.en: Only 1 copy of each large building.

description.zh: 大建筑位于中央版图底层区块。
description.en: Large buildings sit in the bottom section of the central board.

description.zh: 大建筑的采石场折扣上限为 4。
description.en: Large buildings cap the quarry discount at 4.

appearance.zh: 紫色两格高大建筑板块，费用 10、4 VP，印生产建筑加分图标。
appearance.en: Purple double-height large building tile, cost 10, 4 VP, with production-building bonus icon.

description.zh: 费用 10 元、4 VP 的<large_commercial_building>。终局加成（须被占据）：自己<city>中每座小生产建筑（<small_fruit_warehouse>/<small_sugar_mill>，无论是否被占据）+1 VP，每座大生产建筑（<large_fruit_warehouse>/<large_sugar_mill>/<tobacco_storage>/<coffee_roaster>，无论是否被占据）+2 VP。
description.en: A <large_commercial_building> costing 10, worth 4 VP. Endgame bonus (must be occupied): +1 VP for each small production building in your <city> (<small_fruit_warehouse>/<small_sugar_mill>, occupied or not) and +2 VP for each large production building (<large_fruit_warehouse>/<large_sugar_mill>/<tobacco_storage>/<coffee_roaster>, occupied or not).

description.zh: 终局计分加成：每座小生产建筑 +1 VP、每座大生产建筑 +2 VP（均不论是否被占据）。
description.en: Endgame scoring bonus: +1 VP per small production building, +2 VP per large production building (occupied or not).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本建筑被占据，且处于终局计分。
<ontology::condition>.en: This building is occupied and final scoring is underway.

description.zh: 获得 VP：小生产建筑数 ×1 + 大生产建筑数 ×2（计算值，计入总分而非筹码）。
description.en: Gain VP: small production buildings ×1 + large production buildings ×2 (computed into the total score, not chips).

quantity.zh: 小生产建筑数 ×1 + 大生产建筑数 ×2。
quantity.en: Small production buildings ×1 + large production buildings ×2.

appearance.zh: 紫色两格高大建筑板块，费用 10、4 VP，印乡村格数计分表。
appearance.en: Purple double-height large building tile, cost 10, 4 VP, with countryside-space scoring table.

description.zh: 费用 10 元、4 VP 的<large_commercial_building>。终局加成（须被占据）：按<countryside>已填满的格数（庄园和采石场合计）计分——1–9 格 4 VP、10 格 5 VP、11 格 6 VP、12 格 7 VP。板块是否被占据不影响（只数格数）。
description.en: A <large_commercial_building> costing 10, worth 4 VP. Endgame bonus (must be occupied): scored by filled <countryside> spaces (estates and quarries combined) — 1–9 spaces → 4 VP, 10 → 5, 11 → 6, 12 → 7. Occupation of those tiles is irrelevant (spaces only).

description.zh: 终局计分加成：1–9 格 4 VP、10 格 5 VP、11 格 6 VP、12 格 7 VP。
description.en: Endgame scoring bonus: 4/5/6/7 VP for 1–9/10/11/12 filled countryside spaces.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本建筑被占据，且处于终局计分。
<ontology::condition>.en: This building is occupied and final scoring is underway.

description.zh: 获得 VP：按<countryside>已填格数计（计算值）。
description.en: Gain VP by filled countryside spaces (computed).

appearance.zh: 紫色两格高大建筑板块，费用 10、4 VP，印工人计分图标。
appearance.en: Purple double-height large building tile, cost 10, 4 VP, with worker-scoring icon.

description.zh: 费用 10 元、4 VP 的<large_commercial_building>。终局加成（须被占据）：岛上每 3 名工人（庄园、采石场、建筑与<portrait>上的合计，向下取整）+1 VP。例：22 名工人得 7 VP。
description.en: A <large_commercial_building> costing 10, worth 4 VP. Endgame bonus (must be occupied): +1 VP for every 3 workers on your island (on estates, quarries, buildings, and the <portrait> combined, rounded down). Example: 22 workers → 7 VP.

description.zh: 终局计分加成：每 3 名工人 +1 VP（向下取整）。
description.en: Endgame scoring bonus: +1 VP per 3 workers (rounded down).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本建筑被占据，且处于终局计分。
<ontology::condition>.en: This building is occupied and final scoring is underway.

description.zh: 获得 VP：工人总数 ÷ 3 向下取整（计算值）。
description.en: Gain VP: total workers ÷ 3, rounded down (computed).

quantity.zh: 岛上工人总数 ÷ 3，向下取整。
quantity.en: Total workers on the island ÷ 3, rounded down.

appearance.zh: 紫色两格高大建筑板块，费用 10、4 VP，印 VP 筹码计分图标。
appearance.en: Purple double-height large building tile, cost 10, 4 VP, with VP-chip scoring icon.

description.zh: 费用 10 元、4 VP 的<large_commercial_building>。终局加成（须被占据）：游戏中获得的每 4 个 VP 筹码 +1 VP（向下取整）——只数筹码，不含终局计分的建筑 VP 与大建筑加成。例：30 个筹码得 7 VP。
description.en: A <large_commercial_building> costing 10, worth 4 VP. Endgame bonus (must be occupied): +1 VP for every 4 VP chips earned during the game (rounded down) — chips only, excluding endgame building VP and large-building bonuses. Example: 30 chips → 7 VP.

description.zh: 终局计分加成：每 4 个 VP 筹码 +1 VP（向下取整，只数筹码）。
description.en: Endgame scoring bonus: +1 VP per 4 VP chips (rounded down, chips only).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本建筑被占据，且处于终局计分。
<ontology::condition>.en: This building is occupied and final scoring is underway.

description.zh: 获得 VP：游戏中所获 VP 筹码总数 ÷ 4，向下取整（计算值）。
description.en: Gain VP: total VP chips earned during the game ÷ 4, rounded down (computed).

quantity.zh: VP 筹码总数 ÷ 4，向下取整。
quantity.en: Total VP chips ÷ 4, rounded down.

appearance.zh: 紫色两格高大建筑板块，费用 10、4 VP，印商业建筑计分图标。
appearance.en: Purple double-height large building tile, cost 10, 4 VP, with commercial-building scoring icon.

description.zh: 费用 10 元、4 VP 的<large_commercial_building>。终局加成（须被占据）：自己<city>中每座商业建筑 +1 VP——包括所有小商业建筑、所有大商业建筑以及市政厅自身，无论是否被占据。
description.en: A <large_commercial_building> costing 10, worth 4 VP. Endgame bonus (must be occupied): +1 VP for every commercial building in your <city> — all small commercial buildings, all large commercial buildings, and City Hall itself, occupied or not.

description.zh: 终局计分加成：每座商业建筑（含自身）+1 VP，不论是否被占据。
description.en: Endgame scoring bonus: +1 VP per commercial building (including itself), occupied or not.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本建筑被占据，且处于终局计分。
<ontology::condition>.en: This building is occupied and final scoring is underway.

description.zh: 获得 VP：商业建筑总数 ×1（含市政厅自身，计算值）。
description.en: Gain VP: total commercial buildings ×1 (including City Hall itself, computed).

quantity.zh: 商业建筑总数（含自身）。
quantity.en: Total commercial buildings (including itself).

description.zh: 角色卡的外观——卡牌正面印角色名、插画与行动/特权图标。
description.en: Appearance of a role card — the front shows the role name, artwork, and action/privilege icons.

description.zh: 波多黎各中的角色卡——一种<ontology::card>，共 8 张：<planter_card>、<builder_card>、<recruiter_card>、<craftsman_card>、<trader_card>、<captain_card> 各 1 张 + <adventurer_card> 2 张。开局摆在<role_card_area>（3 人局只用 6 张——去掉 2 张冒险家；4 人局 7 张——去掉 1 张冒险家；5 人局全用）。每回合每名玩家选 1 张：选角者执行该角色的行动并享受特权，其他玩家按顺时针只执行行动；除船长外，执行行动是可选的——不能做或不想做的玩家跳过该角色。角色卡留在选角者面前直到回合结束。回合结束时，未被选中的角色卡各放 1 元（由旧总督执行），下次选到该卡的人拿走上面的钱。
description.en: Role cards in Puerto Rico — a type of <ontology::card>, 8 in total: one each of <planter_card>, <builder_card>, <recruiter_card>, <craftsman_card>, <trader_card>, <captain_card>, plus 2 <adventurer_card>s. At setup they sit in the <role_card_area> (3 players use 6 cards — both Adventurers removed; 4 players use 7 — one Adventurer removed; 5 players use all 8). Each round every player picks 1: the chooser performs the role's action with its privilege; the others, clockwise, perform only the action; the role card stays in front of the chooser until the round ends. At round end, 1 coin is placed on each unchosen role card (by the outgoing governor); whoever later picks such a card takes its coins.

description.zh: 此角色的特权——只有选角者享受，其他玩家仅执行行动。
description.en: This role's privilege — enjoyed only by the chooser; others perform the action alone.

description.zh: 每张角色卡都有特权说明。
description.en: Every role card has a privilege description.

appearance.zh: 角色卡——正面印种植园主插画、行动（取庄园）与特权（可采石）图标。
appearance.en: Role card — front shows planter artwork and the action (take estate) / privilege (quarry) icons.

description.zh: 种植园主（Planter）角色卡。行动：从<estate_display>取 1 块明置庄园放到<countryside>。特权：可用<quarry_tile>代替庄园。所有玩家完成后刷新庄园陈列（弃掉剩余的明置庄园，从暗堆翻到玩家数 +1 张）。对应的行动见<planter_role>。
description.en: The Planter role card. Action: take 1 face-up estate from the <estate_display> into your <countryside>. Privilege: you may take a <quarry_tile> instead of an estate. After everyone has acted, the estate display is refreshed (discard remaining face-up estates, flip new ones until player count + 1). The corresponding action is <planter_role>.

advantage.en: You may take a quarry instead of an estate.

appearance.zh: 角色卡——正面印建筑师插画、行动（建 1 座建筑）与特权（减 1 元）图标。
appearance.en: Role card — front shows builder artwork and the action (build 1) / privilege (−1 coin) icons.

description.zh: 建筑师（Builder）角色卡。行动：从<building_supply>买 1 座建筑放到<city>。特权：费用减 1 元。所有玩家按顺时针各可买 1 座（可选）。费用可再按被占据的采石场减免（上限由建筑区块决定）。若建筑师不建建筑，也享受不到减费特权。对应的行动见<builder_role>。
description.en: The Builder role card. Action: buy 1 building from the <building_supply> into your <city>. Privilege: pay 1 coin less. Each player, clockwise, may buy 1 building (optional). Costs are further reduced by occupied quarries (capped by the building's section). If the builder builds nothing, the discount privilege is not received. The corresponding action is <builder_role>.

advantage.en: Pay 1 coin less for the building.

appearance.zh: 角色卡——正面印招募官插画、行动（分发工人）与特权（多 1 名工人）图标。
appearance.en: Role card — front shows recruiter artwork and the action (distribute workers) / privilege (+1 worker) icons.

description.zh: 招募官（Recruiter）角色卡。行动：玩家按顺时针从<work_register>轮流各拿 1 名工人直到拿完，然后放置/移动自己的工人。特权：阶段开始时先从<worker_supply>多拿 1 名。所有玩家完成后，招募官补充登记册：数所有玩家建筑上的空半圆槽，从供应放同样数量（至少玩家数）的工人上去。对应的行动见<recruiter_role>。
description.en: The Recruiter role card. Action: players take 1 worker at a time from the <work_register> in rotation until empty, then place or move their workers. Privilege: take 1 extra worker from the <worker_supply> at the start of the phase. Afterwards, the recruiter repopulates the register: count empty semicircles on all players' buildings and add that many workers (at least the player count) from the supply. The corresponding action is <recruiter_role>.

advantage.zh: 阶段开始时先从工人供应堆多拿 1 名工人。
advantage.en: Take 1 extra worker from the worker supply at the start of the phase.

appearance.zh: 角色卡——正面印工匠插画、行动（生产货物）与特权（多 1 桶）图标。
appearance.en: Role card — front shows craftsman artwork and the action (produce) / privilege (+1 barrel) icons.

description.zh: 工匠（Craftsman）角色卡。行动：按生产能力从<goods_supply>取货物放到<portrait>。特权：阶段结束时，可多拿 1 桶自己本阶段生产过的某种货物。若工匠什么都没生产，特权作废。对应的行动见<craftsman_role>。
description.en: The Craftsman role card. Action: take goods from the <goods_supply> per your production ability onto your <portrait>. Privilege: at the end of the phase, take 1 extra barrel of a good you produced this phase. If the craftsman produces nothing, the privilege is lost. The corresponding action is <craftsman_role>.

advantage.zh: 阶段结束时多拿 1 桶本阶段生产过的货物。
advantage.en: Take 1 extra barrel of a good produced this phase, at its end.

appearance.zh: 角色卡——正面印商人插画、行动（卖 1 桶）与特权（多 1 元）图标。
appearance.en: Role card — front shows trader artwork and the action (sell 1) / privilege (+1 coin) icons.

description.zh: 商人（Trader）角色卡。行动：卖 1 桶货物到<trading_house>，按售价从<bank>拿钱。特权：多得 1 元。每人至多卖 1 桶；每种货物一阶段至多卖 1 桶（有<office>例外）；交易所满 4 桶后不能再卖。若交易所满了，阶段结束时商人清空交易所（4 桶回供应）。若商人什么都没卖，特权作废。对应的行动见<trader_role>。
description.en: The Trader role card. Action: sell 1 barrel to the <trading_house> and take its price from the <bank>. Privilege: +1 extra coin. Each player sells at most 1 barrel; each type sells at most once per phase (unless an <office>); no sales into a full house (4 barrels). If the house is full at phase end, the trader empties it (4 barrels back to the supply). If the trader sells nothing, the privilege is lost. The corresponding action is <trader_role>.

advantage.en: Earn 1 extra coin for the sale.

appearance.zh: 角色卡——正面印船长插画、行动（装船）与特权（多 1 VP）图标。
appearance.en: Role card — front shows captain artwork and the action (load ships) / privilege (+1 VP) icons.

description.zh: 船长（Captain）角色卡。行动：所有玩家轮流向<port>中的货船装货——能装就必须装（唯一强制行动的角色），每人每次装 1 种货物的尽量多的桶，直到无人能装；每桶 1 VP。特权：本阶段只要装了至少 1 桶，多得 1 VP（每阶段只 1 次）。阶段结束：每人至多保留 1 桶（有仓库更多），其余回供应；满载的货船清空离港。对应的行动见<captain_role>。
description.en: The Captain role card. Action: all players take turns loading cargo ships in the <port> — loading is mandatory whenever possible (the only role with a forced action); each load carries as many barrels of 1 type as possible, until no one can load; 1 VP per barrel. Privilege: if you loaded at least 1 barrel this phase, +1 VP (once per phase). Phase end: each player keeps at most 1 barrel (more with warehouses), the rest return to the supply; full ships are emptied and depart. The corresponding action is <captain_role>.

advantage.zh: 本阶段装货 ≥1 桶则多得 1 VP（每阶段 1 次）。
advantage.en: If you loaded at least 1 barrel this phase, +1 VP (once per phase).

appearance.zh: 角色卡——正面印冒险家插画与特权（拿 1 元）图标，无行动。
appearance.en: Role card — front shows adventurer artwork and the privilege (take 1 coin) icon; no action.

description.zh: 冒险家（Adventurer）角色卡，共 2 张（3 人局不用、4 人局用 1 张）。行动：无。特权：选角者从<bank>拿 1 元。因为没有行动，其他玩家无事可做。对应的行动见<adventurer_role>。
description.en: The Adventurer role card, 2 copies (none in 3-player games, 1 in 4-player games). Action: none. Privilege: the chooser takes 1 coin from the <bank>. As there is no action, the other players do nothing. The corresponding action is <adventurer_role>.

description.zh: 波多黎各的起始玩家标记——持有<governor_card>的玩家是本回合的总督：从总督开始顺时针选角色；回合结束时总督卡传给左边玩家。
description.en: The starting player marker of Puerto Rico — the holder is the governor of the round: role selection starts with the governor and proceeds clockwise; the card passes left at round end.

appearance.zh: 印有总督肖像的卡牌。
appearance.en: A card bearing the governor's portrait.

description.zh: 货船的外观——船形板块，印货舱格数（4–8）。
description.en: Appearance of a cargo ship — a ship-shaped tile printed with its hold spaces (4–8).

description.zh: 波多黎各中的货船——承载货舱的一种<ontology::board>，共 5 艘，容量（货舱格数）4–8。按人数用 3 艘：3 人局 4/5/6、4 人局 5/6/7、5 人局 6/7/8，停在<port>。装船规则：每艘船只能装 1 种货物；不同船不能装同一种货物；空船之间选择时必选能装最多桶的那艘；装满的船立即离港（货物回<goods_supply>，船移出游戏）；部分装载的船留到下个装运阶段。
description.en: Cargo ships in Puerto Rico — a type of <ontology::board> hosting a cargo hold; 5 ships with capacities (hold spaces) 4–8. Three are used by player count: 3 players → 4/5/6; 4 → 5/6/7; 5 → 6/7/8, docked in the <port>. Loading rules: each ship carries only 1 type of good; no two ships may carry the same type; when choosing among empty ships, the one allowing the most barrels must be chosen; a full ship departs immediately (barrels to <goods_supply>, ship out of the game); partially loaded ships stay for the next shipment phase.

description.zh: 货舱容量（格数）。装满即离港。
description.en: Cargo hold capacity (spaces). Full ships depart.

description.zh: 每艘货船都有容量。
description.en: Every cargo ship has a capacity.

appearance.zh: 4 舱货船——印 4 个货舱格的船板块。
appearance.en: A ship tile with 4 cargo hold spaces.

description.zh: 容量 4 的<cargo_ship>。仅 3 人局使用。
description.en: A <cargo_ship> with capacity 4. Used only in 3-player games.

appearance.zh: 5 舱货船——印 5 个货舱格的船板块。
appearance.en: A ship tile with 5 cargo hold spaces.

description.zh: 容量 5 的<cargo_ship>。3 人局与 4 人局使用。
description.en: A <cargo_ship> with capacity 5. Used in 3- and 4-player games.

appearance.zh: 6 舱货船——印 6 个货舱格的船板块。
appearance.en: A ship tile with 6 cargo hold spaces.

description.zh: 容量 6 的<cargo_ship>。所有人数局均使用。
description.en: A <cargo_ship> with capacity 6. Used at all player counts.

appearance.zh: 7 舱货船——印 7 个货舱格的船板块。
appearance.en: A ship tile with 7 cargo hold spaces.

description.zh: 容量 7 的<cargo_ship>。4 人局与 5 人局使用。
description.en: A <cargo_ship> with capacity 7. Used in 4- and 5-player games.

appearance.zh: 8 舱货船——印 8 个货舱格的船板块。
appearance.en: A ship tile with 8 cargo hold spaces.

description.zh: 容量 8 的<cargo_ship>。仅 5 人局使用。
description.en: A <cargo_ship> with capacity 8. Used only in 5-player games.

appearance.zh: 交易所小板块——4 个货物位置，印五种货物售价（玉米 0、水果 1、糖 2、烟草 3、咖啡 4）。
appearance.en: Small trading house tile — 4 goods spaces, printed with the five prices (corn 0, fruit 1, sugar 2, tobacco 3, coffee 4).

description.zh: 波多黎各中的交易所——承载<trading_house_slot>的一种<ontology::board>，放在<port>旁。交易所只有 4 个位置，标着五种货物的售价：<corn> 0、<fruit> 1、<sugar> 2、<tobacco> 3、<coffee> 4。规则：同一时间每种货物至多 1 桶（有<office>例外）；满 4 桶后不能再卖；<trader_role>阶段结束时若满则清空（4 桶回<goods_supply>），未满则留到下个贸易阶段。
description.en: The trading house in Puerto Rico — a type of <ontology::board> hosting the <trading_house_slot>, placed beside the <port>. It has 4 spaces, printed with the five prices: <corn> 0, <fruit> 1, <sugar> 2, <tobacco> 3, <coffee> 4. Rules: at most 1 barrel per type at a time (unless an <office>); no sales when full (4 barrels); at the end of the <trader_role> phase it is emptied if full (4 barrels to <goods_supply>), otherwise the barrels remain for the next trade phase.

description.zh: 交易所的 4 个货物位置。
description.en: The trading house's 4 goods spaces.

description.zh: 波多黎各的公共版图。上面放着：49 座建筑（按类型堆在各自位置，见<building_supply>）、全部钱币（<bank>）、<work_register>、<port>（货船停靠处）。旁侧放<estate_display>、<estate_face_down_stack>、<quarry_stack>与<role_card_area>。
description.en: The public board of Puerto Rico. On it sit: the 49 buildings (stacked by type, see <building_supply>), all the coins (<bank>), the <work_register>, and the <port> (ship dock). Beside it lie the <estate_display>, <estate_face_down_stack>, <quarry_stack>, and <role_card_area>.

appearance.zh: 一块大版图：上方是建筑区（四个区块按费用分层），一侧是工作登记册与银行，另一侧是港口。
appearance.en: A large board: the building area on top (four sections by cost), the Work Register and Bank on one side, the port on the other.

description.zh: 工作登记册印在中央版图上，玩家在此排队取工人。
description.en: The Work Register is printed on the central board where players queue for workers.

description.zh: 银行——开局放全部 51 枚钱币。
description.en: The Bank — holds all 51 coins at setup.

description.zh: 49 座建筑按类型堆叠在各自位置上，分四个区块。
description.en: The 49 buildings stacked by type in their spaces, across four sections.

description.zh: 港口——货船与交易所所在。
description.en: The port — where cargo ships and the trading house sit.

description.zh: 波多黎各的玩家版图，每人一块。上半部分<countryside>有 12 个格放庄园与采石场；下半部分<city>有 12 个格放建筑；旁边是<portrait>（放钱币、货物、VP 筹码和无处安放的工人）。版图正反面图案不同（一男一女，纯装饰）。
description.en: The player board of Puerto Rico, one per player. The upper <countryside> has 12 spaces for estates and quarries; the lower <city> has 12 spaces for buildings; beside it is the <portrait> (holding coins, goods, VP chips, and unhoused workers). The two sides show different art (a man and a woman; purely decorative).

appearance.zh: 矩形玩家板：顶部 12 格乡村区（放庄园/采石场），底部 12 格城区（放建筑），侧边为肖像区（钱/货/VP）。
appearance.en: A rectangular player board: 12 countryside spaces on top (estates/quarries), 12 city spaces below (buildings), and the Portrait on the side (coins/goods/VP).

description.zh: 乡村区——12 个格放庄园与采石场板块。
description.en: The countryside — 12 spaces for estate and quarry tiles.

description.zh: 城区——12 个格放建筑板块（大建筑占 2 格）。
description.en: The city — 12 spaces for building tiles (large buildings take 2).

description.zh: 肖像区——放钱币（公开）、货物、VP 筹码（可隐藏）和暂无空槽的工人。
description.en: The Portrait — holds coins (public), goods, VP chips (concealable), and workers awaiting slots.

description.zh: 位于<central_board>上的<ontology::zone>，存放待分发的<worker>。开局放「玩家数」名工人。每次<recruiter_role>阶段：玩家按顺时针轮流各拿 1 名直到拿完；阶段结束时招募官补充——数所有玩家岛上建筑（不含庄园/采石场）的空半圆槽数，从<worker_supply>放同样数量（至少玩家数）的工人。若工人不够补充，触发终局条件。
description.en: A <ontology::zone> on the <central_board> holding <worker>s awaiting distribution. At setup it holds a number equal to the player count. Each <recruiter_role> phase: players take 1 worker each in rotation until empty; at phase end the recruiter repopulates it — count the empty semicircles on building tiles (not estates or quarries) across all players' boards and add that many workers from the <worker_supply> (at least the player count). If there are not enough workers to repopulate, an endgame condition triggers.

description.zh: 此区域存放的对象类型：<worker>。
description.en: The object type this zone holds: <worker>.

description.zh: 波多黎各中的钱币供应堆——开局放全部 51 枚<coin>（43 枚 1 元银币 + 8 枚 5 元金币）。玩家从银行拿钱的途径：<trader_role>出售货物、<adventurer_role>、<factory>奖励、选到带钱的角色卡。玩家付钱（买建筑、回合结束给角色卡放钱）时钱回银行。
description.en: The coin supply of Puerto Rico — holds all 51 <coin>s at setup (43 one-value silver + 8 five-value gold). Players take coins from the bank via: selling goods in the <trader_role>, the <adventurer_role>, <factory> rewards, and picking a role card with coins on it. Coins paid (for buildings, and those placed on role cards at round end) return to the bank.

description.zh: 此供应堆存放的对象类型：<coin>。
description.en: The object type this supply holds: <coin>.

description.zh: 波多黎各中的工人供应堆。开局放入 3 人局 55 名、4 人局 75 名、5 人局 95 名<worker>。来源：<recruiter_role>特权、<hospital>、<school>从这里取工人；<work_register>补充时从这里搬。若此堆为空，招募官特权作废；若登记册补充时不够，触发终局条件。
description.en: The worker supply of Puerto Rico. At setup it holds 55 workers for 3 players, 75 for 4, 95 for 5. Sources: the <recruiter_role> privilege, <hospital>, and <school> take workers from here; <work_register> repopulation draws from here. If this supply is empty, the recruiter's privilege is lost; if repopulation cannot be completed, an endgame condition triggers.

description.zh: 此供应堆存放的对象类型：<worker>。
description.en: The object type this supply holds: <worker>.

description.zh: 波多黎各中的货物供应堆。开局按颜色放全部 50 桶<good>（玉米 10、水果 11、糖 11、烟草 9、咖啡 9）。生产时从这里取；售出、装船（满载离港/包租船）与阶段结束弃货时回这里。某色货物被拿完时，后面的人生产不了该色。
description.en: The goods supply of Puerto Rico. At setup it holds all 50 <good> barrels by color (10 corn, 11 fruit, 11 sugar, 9 tobacco, 9 coffee). Production takes from here; sales, shipping (departed full ships / chartered ship), and forfeited end-of-phase barrels return here. When a color runs out, later players cannot produce that good.

description.zh: 此供应堆存放的对象类型：<good>（五种）。
description.en: The object type this supply holds: <good> (all five types).

description.zh: 波多黎各中的 VP 筹码供应堆。开局按人数放筹码：3 人局 75 VP、4 人局 100 VP、5 人局 126 VP（1 分筹码 31 枚 + 5 分筹码 19 枚的组合）。<captain_role>装船、<harbor>、<wharf>从这里拿筹码。筹码拿完即触发终局条件之一，之后用纸笔记录 VP。
description.en: The VP chip supply of Puerto Rico. At setup it holds chips per player count: 75 VP for 3 players, 100 for 4, 126 for 5 (a mix of 31 one-VP chips and 19 five-VP chips). Shipping in the <captain_role>, <harbor>, and <wharf> take chips from here. When the chips run out, an endgame condition triggers and VP are tracked on paper.

quantity.zh: VP 筹码总量按人数
quantity.en: Total VP chips by player count

description.zh: 此供应堆存放的对象类型：<victory_point>筹码（1 分/5 分）。
description.en: The object type this supply holds: <victory_point> chips (value 1 and 5).

description.zh: 摆在<central_board>旁的明置庄园<ontology::market>，开局从<estate_face_down_stack>翻出「玩家数 +1」块（3 人 4 块、4 人 5 块、5 人 6 块）正面朝上陈列。<planter_role>阶段玩家从这里取庄园；阶段结束由种植园主刷新：弃掉剩余的明置庄园到<estate_discard>，再从暗堆翻到「玩家数 +1」块。
description.en: The face-up estate <ontology::market> beside the <central_board>, set up with 'player count + 1' tiles (4/5/6 for 3/4/5 players) flipped face-up from the <estate_face_down_stack>. Players take estates from here during the <planter_role> phase; at phase end the planter refreshes it: remaining face-up estates go to the <estate_discard>, then new ones are flipped until player count + 1.

description.zh: 陈列庄园数 = 玩家数 + 1（<planter_role>阶段结束刷新时同样补到玩家数 + 1）。
description.en: Displayed estates = player count + 1 (refilled to the same after the <planter_role> phase).

description.zh: 此市场陈列的对象类型：<estate_tile>（正面朝上）。
description.en: The object type this market displays: <estate_tile> (face-up).

description.zh: 开局把剩余庄园洗混后的背面朝上<ontology::deck>（共 58 块岛屿板块中的庄园部分）。用途：开局翻出<estate_display>、<planter_role>阶段刷新陈列、<hacienda>抽额外庄园。若暗堆抽空而<estate_discard>有牌，洗混弃牌堆形成新暗堆；两者都空时种植行动无法进行。
description.en: The face-down <ontology::deck> of remaining estates after shuffling at setup. Uses: revealing the <estate_display> at setup, refreshing the display in the <planter_role> phase, and the <hacienda> extra draw. If the stacks run out while the <estate_discard> has tiles, shuffle the discard into new stacks; if both are empty, the planting action cannot be performed.

description.zh: 此牌堆存放的对象类型：<estate_tile>（背面朝上）。
description.en: The object type this deck holds: <estate_tile> (face-down).

description.zh: 每次<planter_role>阶段结束刷新<estate_display>时，被弃掉的明置庄园进入此<ontology::discard_pile>。暗堆抽空时洗混此堆形成新暗堆。
description.en: When the <estate_display> is refreshed at the end of each <planter_role> phase, the discarded face-up estates go into this <ontology::discard_pile>. When the face-down stacks run out, this pile is shuffled into new stacks.

description.zh: 此弃牌堆存放的对象类型：<estate_tile>。
description.en: The object type this pile holds: <estate_tile>.

description.zh: 摆在<central_board>旁的采石场<ontology::supply>，8 块<quarry_tile>全部正面朝上叠放。只有<planter_role>选角者（特权）或有<builders_yard>的非选角者能从这里取采石场。采石场取完时种植园主特权与建筑工棚功能作废。
description.en: The quarry <ontology::supply> beside the <central_board> — all 8 <quarry_tile>s face-up in a stack. Only the <planter_role> chooser (privilege) or a non-chooser with a <builders_yard> may take a quarry from here. When empty, the planter's privilege and the builders yard stop working.

description.zh: 此供应堆存放的对象类型：<quarry_tile>。
description.en: The object type this supply holds: <quarry_tile>.

description.zh: <central_board>上的建筑<ontology::market>，49 座<building>按类型堆叠在各自位置、正面朝上供选择。玩家在<builder_role>阶段从这里购买建筑。某类型建筑被买完后无法再建。
description.en: The building <ontology::market> on the <central_board> — all 49 <building>s stacked by type in their spaces, face-up for selection. Players buy buildings from here during the <builder_role> phase. When a type runs out, it can no longer be built.

description.zh: 此市场陈列的对象类型：<building>（全部 49 座，按类型堆叠）。
description.en: The object type this market holds: <building> (all 49, stacked by type).

description.zh: 摆在<central_board>旁的角色卡<ontology::market>。开局放 6/7/8 张<role_card>（3 人局去 2 张冒险家、4 人局去 1 张）。每回合每名玩家从这里选 1 张卡；选走的卡留在玩家面前直到回合结束才归还。回合结束时未被选的卡各放 1 元。
description.en: The role card <ontology::market> beside the <central_board>. At setup it holds 6/7/8 <role_card>s (3 players remove both Adventurers, 4 players remove one). Each round, every player picks one card from here; picked cards stay in front of their players until the round ends. At round end, 1 coin is placed on each unchosen card.

description.zh: 此市场陈列的对象类型：<role_card>。
description.en: The object type this market holds: <role_card>.

description.zh: <central_board>旁的港口区<ontology::zone>，停靠 3 艘<cargo_ship>与<trading_house>。
description.en: The port <ontology::zone> beside the <central_board>, docking the 3 <cargo_ship>s and the <trading_house>.

description.zh: 此区域存放的对象类型：<cargo_ship>与<trading_house>。
description.en: The object types this zone holds: <cargo_ship> and <trading_house>.

description.zh: 每艘<cargo_ship>承载的货舱<ontology::zone>，容量 4–8。规则：每艘船只能装 1 种<good>；不同船不能装同一种；装满即离港（货物回<goods_supply>，船移出游戏）；部分装载留到下个装运阶段。
description.en: The cargo hold <ontology::zone> hosted by each <cargo_ship>, capacity 4–8. Rules: each ship carries only 1 type of <good>; no two ships may carry the same type; full ships depart (barrels to <goods_supply>, ship removed); partial loads stay for the next shipment phase.

description.zh: 此区域存放的对象类型：<good>（同一船上仅 1 种）。
description.en: The object type this zone holds: <good> (only 1 type per ship).

description.zh: 货舱容量，由所在<cargo_ship>决定（4–8）。
description.en: Hold capacity, set by the hosting <cargo_ship> (4–8).

description.zh: <trading_house>承载的 4 个货物位置。规则：同一时间每种<good>至多 1 桶（有<office>例外）；满 4 桶后不能再卖；<trader_role>阶段结束若满则清空回<goods_supply>，未满留到下个贸易阶段。
description.en: The 4 goods spaces hosted by the <trading_house>. Rules: at most 1 barrel per <good> type at a time (unless an <office>); no sales when full at 4 barrels; emptied to <goods_supply> at the end of the <trader_role> phase if full, otherwise the barrels remain.

description.zh: 此区域存放的对象类型：<good>（每种至多 1 桶）。
description.en: The object type this zone holds: <good> (at most 1 barrel per type).

description.zh: 交易所容量，固定为 4。
description.en: Trading house capacity, fixed at 4.

description.zh: <island_board>上半部分的<ontology::player_zone>，12 个格放<estate_tile>与<quarry_tile>。板块一旦放入不可移出版图（可在 12 格内挪位）。12 格全满后不能执行种植行动。
description.en: The <ontology::player_zone> in the upper half of the <island_board>, with 12 spaces for <estate_tile>s and <quarry_tile>s. Once placed, a tile may not leave the board (it can be rearranged within the 12 spaces). With all 12 spaces filled, the planting action is unavailable.

description.zh: 此区域存放的对象类型：<estate_tile>与<quarry_tile>。
description.en: The object types this zone holds: <estate_tile> and <quarry_tile>.

description.zh: 乡村区容量，固定为 12 格。
description.en: Countryside capacity, fixed at 12 spaces.

description.zh: 从<ontology::player_zone>继承，<countryside>始终归属于一个<ontology::player>。
description.en: Inherited from <ontology::player_zone>, the <countryside> always belongs to a <ontology::player>.

description.zh: <island_board>下半部分的<ontology::player_zone>，12 个格放<building>。大建筑占 2 个相邻格。12 格全满后不能执行建造行动；只剩 1 格时不能建大建筑。12 格全满是终局条件之一。
description.en: The <ontology::player_zone> in the lower half of the <island_board>, with 12 spaces for <building>s. Large buildings take 2 adjacent spaces. With all 12 filled, the build action is unavailable; with only 1 space left, no large building can be built. Filling all 12 spaces is an endgame condition.

description.zh: 此区域存放的对象类型：<building>。
description.en: The object type this zone holds: <building>.

description.zh: 城区容量，固定为 12 格（大建筑占 2 格）。
description.en: City capacity, fixed at 12 spaces (large buildings take 2).

description.zh: 从<ontology::player_zone>继承，<city>始终归属于一个<ontology::player>。
description.en: Inherited from <ontology::player_zone>, the <city> always belongs to a <ontology::player>.

description.zh: <island_board>侧边的<ontology::player_holding>，存放该玩家的<coin>（必须公开）、<good>（可无限堆放）、<victory_point>筹码（可背面朝上隐藏——游戏中唯一的隐藏信息）与无处安放的<worker>（岛上无空半圆槽时暂存于此，留待以后的招募阶段放置）。
description.en: The <ontology::player_holding> on the side of the <island_board>, holding the player's <coin>s (must be public), <good>s (unlimited stacking), <victory_point> chips (may be face-down — the only hidden information in the game), and unhoused <worker>s (kept here when no empty semicircle remains, placed in a future recruitment phase).

description.zh: 此区域存放的对象类型：<coin>、<good>、<victory_point>与<worker>。
description.en: The object types this zone holds: <coin>, <good>, <victory_point>, and <worker>.

description.zh: 从<ontology::player_holding>继承，<portrait>始终归属于一个<ontology::player>。
description.en: Inherited from <ontology::player_holding>, the <portrait> always belongs to a <ontology::player>.

description.zh: 波多黎各中每回合唯一的行动：从<role_card_area>选 1 张<role_card>放在自己面前——拿走卡上已有的钱（若有）。随后结算该角色阶段：选角者执行行动并享受特权，其他玩家按顺时针只执行行动。重要：除船长外，执行角色的行动是可选的——不能做或不想做的玩家跳过该角色（选角者跳过则特权也作废）。选走的卡直到回合结束不能再次被选。每回合每名玩家恰好选 1 次。
description.en: The single action of each turn in Puerto Rico: pick 1 <role_card> from the <role_card_area> and place it in front of you — taking any coins on the card. Then the role phase resolves: the chooser performs the action with the privilege; the others, clockwise, perform only the action. Important: except for the Captain, performing a role's action is optional — a player who cannot or does not want to act is skipped for that role (a chooser who skips also loses the privilege). A picked card cannot be chosen again this round. Each player picks exactly once per round.

description.zh: 将所选<role_card>从<role_card_area>移到选角者面前。
description.en: Move the chosen <role_card> from the <role_card_area> to in front of the chooser.

name.en: Take Coins on the Role Card

description.zh: 若所选<role_card>上有回合结束放置的钱币，全部拿走放到<portrait>。
description.en: If the chosen <role_card> carries coins from round-end placements, take them all to the <portrait>.

quantity.zh: 该角色卡上的全部钱币。
quantity.en: All coins on that role card.

description.zh: 种植阶段行动。选角者可用<quarry_tile>代替庄园（特权），其他玩家从<estate_display>取明置庄园（有<builders_yard>才可选采石场）。庄园/采石场放到<countryside>的空格。全员完成后刷新<estate_display>：弃掉剩余明置庄园，从暗堆翻到「玩家数 +1」块。12 格全满者不能种植；采石场没了特权作废。相关建筑：<hacienda>（正常行动前先暗抽 1 块）、<hospital>（放板块时上 1 名工人）。
description.en: The planting phase action. The chooser may take a <quarry_tile> instead of an estate (privilege); the others take a face-up estate from the <estate_display> (a quarry only with a <builders_yard>). Estates and quarries go onto empty <countryside> spaces. After everyone has acted, refresh the <estate_display>: discard remaining face-up estates and flip new ones until player count + 1. Players with all 12 spaces filled cannot plant; when quarries run out the privilege is lost. Related buildings: <hacienda> (blind-draw 1 estate before the normal action), <hospital> (a worker onto the placed tile).

quantity.zh: 阶段结束刷新<estate_display>时抽的庄园数按人数（玩家数 +1）。
quantity.en: Estates drawn to refresh the <estate_display> at phase end, by player count (players + 1).

description.zh: 有被占据的<hacienda>的玩家，在正常种植前从<estate_face_down_stack>顶抽 1 块庄园并立即放到<countryside>（可选、不可丢弃）。
description.en: A player with an occupied <hacienda> may draw 1 estate from the top of the <estate_face_down_stack> and place it in the <countryside> immediately, before their normal planting (optional, cannot be discarded).

description.zh: 从选角者开始顺时针，每名玩家各取 1 块板块放到<countryside>：明置庄园人人可拿；采石场只有选角者（特权）或有<builders_yard>者可拿。<hospital>：放置板块时从<worker_supply>（空则<work_register>）拿 1 名工人放上去。
description.en: Starting with the chooser and going clockwise, each player takes 1 tile into their <countryside>: face-up estates for everyone; quarries only for the chooser (privilege) or a <builders_yard> owner. <hospital>: when placing the tile, take 1 worker from the <worker_supply> (or the <work_register> if empty) onto it.

description.zh: 从<estate_display>选 1 块庄园放到自己的<countryside>空格。
description.en: Take 1 estate from the <estate_display> onto an empty <countryside> space.

description.zh: 选角者（特权）从<quarry_stack>取 1 块采石场放到自己的<countryside>空格。
description.en: The chooser (privilege) takes 1 quarry from the <quarry_stack> onto an empty <countryside> space.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 自己是本阶段选种植园主的玩家，且<quarry_available>成立。
<ontology::condition>.en: You are this phase's planter chooser and <quarry_available> holds.

name.en: Take a Quarry via Builders Yard

description.zh: 非选角者凭被占据的<builders_yard>从<quarry_stack>取 1 块采石场放到自己的<countryside>空格。
description.en: A non-chooser with an occupied <builders_yard> takes 1 quarry from the <quarry_stack> onto an empty <countryside> space.

description.zh: 种植是可选的——不想拿、没空格或没有可选板块时都可以跳过（除船长外，角色行动均可选）。
description.en: Planting is optional — you may skip when unwilling, when no space remains, or when no tile is available (all role actions except the Captain's are optional).

description.zh: 若<estate_face_down_stack>已空而<estate_discard>有庄园，洗混弃牌堆形成新暗堆。两者皆空则无法翻新陈列，种植行动作废。
description.en: If the <estate_face_down_stack> is empty but the <estate_discard> has estates, shuffle the discard into new stacks. If both are empty, the display cannot be refilled and the planting action is void.

description.zh: 建造阶段行动。选角者买 1 座建筑且费用减 1 元（特权），其他玩家按顺时针可各买 1 座（可选、原价）。费用 = 建筑费用 − 被占据采石场数（上限由建筑区块决定：顶层 1、第二层 2、第三层 3、大建筑 4）− 选角者特权 1 元。每名玩家每种建筑至多 1 座；建筑放到<city>的空格（大建筑需 2 个相邻空格）。若不建建筑，选角者的减费特权作废。12 格全满不能建造。相关建筑：<school>（建成时上 1 名工人）。
description.en: The build phase action. The chooser buys 1 building at 1 coin less (privilege); the others, clockwise, may each buy 1 (optional, full price). Cost = building cost − occupied quarries (capped by section: top 1, second 2, third 3, large 4) − 1 for the chooser's privilege. Each player may build each building type at most once; buildings go onto empty <city> spaces (large buildings need 2 adjacent spaces). If the chooser builds nothing, the discount privilege is lost. Building is impossible with all 12 spaces filled. Related building: <school> (a worker onto the new building).

description.zh: 从选角者开始顺时针，每名玩家可买 1 座建筑。
description.en: Starting with the chooser and going clockwise, each player may buy 1 building.

description.zh: 从<portrait>付钱到<bank>：费用 = 建筑费用 − 被占据采石场数（≤ 区块上限）− 选角者特权 1 元。
description.en: Pay from the <portrait> to the <bank>: cost = building cost − occupied quarries (≤ section cap) − 1 for the chooser's privilege.

quantity.zh: 建筑费用 − 采石场折扣 − 选角者特权。
quantity.en: Building cost − quarry discount − chooser privilege.

description.zh: 将买到的<building>从<building_supply>放到自己<city>的空格（大建筑 2 个相邻空格）。
description.en: Move the bought <building> from the <building_supply> onto empty <city> spaces (2 adjacent for large buildings).

description.zh: 有被占据的<school>时，从<worker_supply>（空则<work_register>）拿 1 名工人放到刚建成的建筑上（仅 1 名）。
description.en: With an occupied <school>, take 1 worker from the <worker_supply> (or the <work_register> if empty) onto the new building (only 1).

destination.en: A semicircle of the newly built building.

description.zh: 不购买建筑（建造是可选的）。
description.en: Buy nothing (building is optional).

description.zh: 招募阶段行动。选角者先从<worker_supply>多拿 1 名（特权）；然后所有玩家从<work_register>轮流各拿 1 名直到拿完（人数可能不均）——拿工人也是可选的，不想拿的玩家跳过，工人继续轮给其他人；之后每人放置/移动自己的工人——工人只能放在板块空半圆槽上，可移动上一回合已放的工人；岛上无空槽时多余工人放<portrait>，留待以后招募阶段。全员完成后招募官补充登记册：数所有玩家岛上建筑（不含庄园/采石场）的空半圆槽，从<worker_supply>放同样数量（至少玩家数）。工人供应不足时特权作废；登记册补不齐时触发终局条件。
description.en: The recruitment phase action. The chooser first takes 1 extra worker from the <worker_supply> (privilege); then all players take workers from the <work_register> one at a time in rotation until empty (amounts may differ); then each player places or moves their workers — workers only go on empty semicircles of tiles; workers from previous rounds may be moved; with no empty slot left, surplus workers sit on the <portrait> for future recruitment phases. Afterwards, the recruiter repopulates the register: count empty semicircles on building tiles (not estates or quarries) across all players' boards and add that many workers from the <worker_supply> (at least the player count). An empty worker supply voids the privilege; a failed repopulation triggers an endgame condition.

description.zh: 选角者从<worker_supply>拿 1 名工人（不是从<work_register>）。
description.en: The chooser takes 1 worker from the <worker_supply> (not the <work_register>).

description.zh: 从选角者开始顺时针，每名玩家轮流从<work_register>拿 1 名工人，直到拿完。除船长外行动都可选——不想拿的玩家可以跳过，工人继续轮给其他玩家；若所有人都不拿，工人就留在登记册上。
description.en: Starting with the chooser and going clockwise, each player takes 1 worker from the <work_register> in rotation until it is empty. Actions other than the Captain's are optional — a player may skip, and the workers keep rotating among the others; if nobody takes any, they stay on the register.

description.zh: 每名玩家把本阶段得到的（以及此前阶段暂存的）工人放到空半圆槽上；也可移动之前已放的工人到其他板块。只有<recruiter_role>阶段才能放置/移动工人。若岛上已无空半圆槽，剩余工人放<portrait>。
description.en: Each player places workers gained this phase (and any kept from earlier) on empty semicircles; workers placed in previous rounds may also be moved between tiles. Workers may only be placed or moved during the <recruiter_role> phase. With no empty semicircle left, remaining workers go on the <portrait>.

description.zh: 数所有玩家岛上建筑板块（不含庄园/采石场）的空半圆槽数 N，从<worker_supply>放 max(N, 玩家数) 名工人到<work_register>。若供应不足，放多少算多少——触发<not_enough_workers_to_repopulate>终局条件（回合结束游戏结束）。
description.en: Count the empty semicircles N on building tiles (not estates or quarries) across all players' boards and add max(N, player count) workers from the <worker_supply> to the <work_register>. If the supply falls short, add what remains — triggering the <not_enough_workers_to_repopulate> endgame condition (the game ends at round end).

quantity.zh: max(所有玩家建筑空半圆槽总数, 玩家数)。
quantity.en: max(total empty building semicircles across all players, player count).

description.zh: 生产阶段行动。每名玩家按生产能力从<goods_supply>取货物到<portrait>：每座被占据的<corn_estate>产 1 桶<corn>；其余货物产量 = min(该作物被占据庄园数, 该作物生产建筑上被占据半圆槽数)。某色货物供应不足时，后面的玩家拿不到。选角者特权：阶段结束时多拿 1 桶本阶段生产过的货物（没生产则作废）。相关建筑：<factory>（按生产种类数得钱）。
description.en: The production phase action. Each player takes goods from the <goods_supply> onto the <portrait> per their production ability: each occupied <corn_estate> produces 1 <corn> barrel; other goods produce min(occupied estates of that crop, occupied semicircles on that crop's production buildings). When a color runs out, later players get nothing of it. Chooser privilege: at phase end, 1 extra barrel of a good produced this phase (void if nothing was produced). Related building: <factory> (coins by number of produced types).

description.zh: 从选角者开始顺时针，每名玩家按生产能力取货（生产是可选的，不想拿的玩家跳过）：每座被占据的<corn_estate>产 1 桶<corn>；<fruit>/<sugar>/<tobacco>/<coffee>产量 = min(被占据庄园数, 对应生产建筑被占据半圆槽数)。
description.en: Starting with the chooser and going clockwise, each player takes goods per production ability (production is optional — a player who does not want the goods is skipped): 1 <corn> per occupied <corn_estate>; <fruit>/<sugar>/<tobacco>/<coffee> produce min(occupied estates, occupied semicircles on the matching production buildings).

quantity.zh: 按生产能力逐种计算。
quantity.en: Computed per good type from production ability.

description.zh: 生产是可选的——不想拿可以跳过（除船长外，角色行动均可选）。
description.en: Production is optional — skip if the goods are unwanted (all role actions except the Captain's are optional).

description.zh: 选角者若本阶段生产了至少 1 桶，多拿 1 桶本阶段生产过的某种货物。
description.en: If the chooser produced at least 1 barrel this phase, they take 1 extra barrel of a good produced this phase.

description.zh: 贸易阶段行动。选角者卖 1 桶货物到<trading_house>并多得 1 元（特权），其他玩家按顺时针可各卖 1 桶（可选）。售价：<corn> 0、<fruit> 1、<sugar> 2、<tobacco> 3、<coffee> 4。限制：同一时间交易所中每种货物至多 1 桶（有<office>例外）；满 4 桶后不能再卖。阶段结束若交易所满，商人清空（4 桶回<goods_supply>），未满则留到下个贸易阶段。相关建筑：<small_market>（+1 元）、<large_market>（+2 元，与前者叠加共 3）。
description.en: The trade phase action. The chooser sells 1 barrel to the <trading_house> and earns 1 extra coin (privilege); the others, clockwise, may each sell 1 barrel (optional). Prices: <corn> 0, <fruit> 1, <sugar> 2, <tobacco> 3, <coffee> 4. Restrictions: at most 1 barrel per type in the house at a time (unless an <office>); no sales when the house is full at 4 barrels. At phase end, if the house is full the trader empties it (4 barrels to the <goods_supply>); otherwise barrels remain for the next trade phase. Related buildings: <small_market> (+1 coin), <large_market> (+2, stacking with the former to +3).

description.zh: 从选角者开始顺时针，每名玩家可卖 1 桶货物。
description.en: Starting with the chooser and going clockwise, each player may sell 1 barrel.

name.en: Place the Barrel in the House

description.zh: 从<bank>拿售价：货物售价 + 选角者特权 1 元 + <small_market> 1 元 + <large_market> 2 元（可叠加）。
description.en: Take from the <bank>: the good's price + 1 for the chooser privilege + 1 for <small_market> + 2 for <large_market> (stacking).

quantity.zh: 售价 + 特权 + 市场加成。
quantity.en: Price + privilege + market bonuses.

description.zh: 不卖货物（出售是可选的）。
description.en: Sell nothing (selling is optional).

description.zh: 若交易所满 4 桶，商人把 4 桶全部放回<goods_supply>。未满则不清空，留到下个贸易阶段。
description.en: If the house is full at 4 barrels, the trader returns all 4 to the <goods_supply>. If not full, they remain for the next trade phase.

description.zh: 装运阶段行动——唯一的强制行动：能装货的玩家必须装。从选角者开始顺时针轮流装船，每人每次把 1 种货物的尽量多的桶装上 1 艘船，直到无人能装；每桶 1 VP。有<wharf>的玩家在轮到自己装货时，可以改用码头包租船装一种货物的全部桶来代替装普通船（每阶段一次）——只要轮到你时还有货可装，装普通船或码头必须选一个，不能什么都不装。装船规则：每艘船只装 1 种货物；不同船不装同一种；多个空船可选时必选能装最多的那艘；不能留桶不装（船上有空位就得装）。选角者特权：本阶段装了 ≥1 桶则多得 1 VP（每阶段 1 次）。阶段结束：每人至多保留 1 桶（有<small_warehouse>可保留 1 种全部、<large_warehouse> 2 种全部、两者叠加 3 种），其余回<goods_supply>；满载的船清空离港。相关建筑：<harbor>（每次装货 +1 VP）、<wharf>（包租船，每阶段 1 次）。
description.en: The shipment phase action — the only forced action: whoever can load must load. Starting with the chooser and going clockwise, players take turns loading as many barrels of 1 type as possible onto 1 ship, until no one can load; 1 VP per barrel. A player with a <wharf> may instead use the chartered ship on their loading turn, shipping all barrels of 1 type (once per phase) — whenever it is your turn and you still have loadable goods, you must choose one: a cargo ship or the chartered ship; doing neither is not allowed. Loading rules: each ship carries only 1 type; no two ships carry the same type; among multiple empty ships the one allowing the most barrels must be chosen; barrels may not be held back while a ship has open spots. Chooser privilege: if they loaded ≥1 barrel this phase, +1 VP (once per phase). Phase end: each player keeps at most 1 barrel (with <small_warehouse> all of 1 extra type, <large_warehouse> 2 extra types, both together 3), the rest return to the <goods_supply>; full ships are emptied and depart. Related buildings: <harbor> (+1 VP per load), <wharf> (chartered ship, once per phase).

description.zh: 从选角者开始顺时针轮流装船，反复进行直到无人能装。
description.en: Players load in rotation starting with the chooser, repeating until no one can load.

description.zh: 当前玩家必须装货（<can_ship_goods>成立即强制）：选 1 种货物，把尽量多的桶装上 1 艘船——船类型唯一、船间类型不重、空船选装得最多的。有码头的玩家这一轮可改用码头包租船装一种货物的全部桶代替，同样算履行装货义务。
description.en: The current player must load (<can_ship_goods> forces it): choose 1 good type and load as many barrels as possible onto 1 ship — one type per ship, no type on two ships, the empty ship holding the most must be chosen. A wharf owner may instead use the chartered ship this round to ship all barrels of 1 type, which equally satisfies the loading obligation.
