quantity.zh: 所选 1 种货物的尽量多的桶（≤ 船剩余空间）。
quantity.en: As many barrels of the chosen type as possible (≤ remaining hold space).

description.zh: 每桶 1 VP（从<vp_supply>取筹码；<harbor>每次装货额外 +1 VP；筹码用完纸笔记录）。
description.en: 1 VP per barrel (chips from the <vp_supply>; <harbor> adds +1 per load; track on paper if chips run out).

quantity.zh: 装船桶数（<harbor>再加 1）。
quantity.en: Barrels loaded (+1 with <harbor>).

description.zh: 选角者本阶段若装了至少 1 桶，多得 1 VP（每阶段至多 1 次）。
description.en: If the chooser loaded at least 1 barrel this phase, they gain 1 extra VP (at most once per phase).

description.zh: 有被占据的<wharf>的玩家可把任意 1 种货物的全部桶装包租船（每阶段至多 1 次，可选）。时点自由：可在装运阶段任意时刻使用——包括装普通船之前、装船轮次之间或全部装完之后；一旦某货物被包租，它就不在手上，之后的装船轮次自然没有它可装。用它装货即履行该轮装货义务：轮到自己装货时，装普通船或码头必选其一。桶全部回<goods_supply>，每桶 1 VP。
description.en: A player with an occupied <wharf> may load all barrels of any 1 type onto the chartered ship (at most once per phase, optional). Timing is free: usable at any point in the shipment phase — before loading cargo ships, between loading rounds, or after all loading; once a good is chartered it is gone, so later loading rounds simply have nothing of it to load. Using it satisfies that round's loading obligation: on your loading turn, you must pick one — cargo ship or chartered ship. All barrels return to the <goods_supply>, 1 VP per barrel.

quantity.zh: 所选 1 种货物的全部桶。
quantity.en: All barrels of the chosen type.

quantity.zh: 装包桶数（<harbor>再加 1）。
quantity.en: Barrels chartered (+1 with <harbor>).

description.zh: 每名玩家至多保留 1 桶货物（有<small_warehouse>可额外保留 1 种全部、<large_warehouse> 2 种、叠加 3 种），其余全部放回<goods_supply>。
description.en: Each player keeps at most 1 barrel (with <small_warehouse> all of 1 extra type, <large_warehouse> 2 extra types, both 3), the rest return to the <goods_supply>.

quantity.zh: 持有桶数 − 可保留数（1 + 仓库加成）。
quantity.en: Barrels held − keepable (1 + warehouse bonuses).

description.zh: 满载的货船清空（货物回<goods_supply>）并移出游戏；部分装载的船保留货物到下个装运阶段。
description.en: Full ships are emptied (barrels to the <goods_supply>) and leave the game; partially loaded ships keep their cargo for the next shipment phase.

quantity.zh: 所有满载货船上的全部货物。
quantity.en: All barrels on all full ships.

description.zh: 冒险家阶段行动。没有行动：选角者从<bank>拿 1 元（特权），其他玩家无事可做。3 人局不使用冒险家卡，4 人局用 1 张，5 人局用 2 张。
description.en: The adventurer phase action. No action: the chooser takes 1 coin from the <bank> (privilege); the other players do nothing. 3-player games use no Adventurer cards, 4-player games use 1, 5-player games use 2.

description.zh: 选角者从<bank>拿 1 元放到<portrait>。
description.en: The chooser takes 1 coin from the <bank> to the <portrait>.

description.zh: 该角色对应的<role_card>还在<role_card_area>中——已被选走（留在选角者面前）或本局未启用（如 3 人局没有冒险家）的角色不可选。
description.en: The corresponding <role_card> is still in the <role_card_area> — cards already picked (kept by their chooser) or not in play (e.g., no Adventurers in a 3-player game) are unavailable.

description.zh: <quarry_stack>中至少还有 1 块<quarry_tile>。
description.en: At least 1 <quarry_tile> remains in the <quarry_stack>.

description.zh: <estate_display>中至少还有 1 块庄园，且自己<countryside>有空格。
description.en: At least 1 estate remains in the <estate_display> and the player has an empty <countryside> space.

description.zh: <estate_face_down_stack>已被抽空。此时若<estate_discard>有庄园，先洗混弃牌堆形成新暗堆再继续翻牌。
description.en: The <estate_face_down_stack> is empty. If the <estate_discard> still has estates, shuffle it into new stacks before continuing to flip.

description.zh: 自己的<hacienda>上有至少 1 名工人。
description.en: The player's <hacienda> has at least 1 worker.

description.zh: 自己的<builders_yard>上有至少 1 名工人，且自己不是本阶段选角者（选角者本身就有采石场特权）。
description.en: The player's <builders_yard> has at least 1 worker, and the player is not this phase's chooser (the chooser already has the quarry privilege).

description.zh: 自己的<school>上有至少 1 名工人。
description.en: The player's <school> has at least 1 worker.

description.zh: 自己的<wharf>上有至少 1 名工人，且本阶段尚未使用过包租船。
description.en: The player's <wharf> has at least 1 worker, and the chartered ship has not been used this phase.

description.zh: 目标<building>在<building_supply>中还有库存（每名玩家每种建筑至多 1 座，此条件在玩家层面排除已建过的），自己<city>有足够空格（大建筑需 2 个相邻空格），且钱够付（建筑费用 − 采石场折扣 − 选角者特权）。
description.en: The target <building> still has copies in the <building_supply> (a player may own each type at most once — this condition excludes it at the player level), the player's <city> has enough space (2 adjacent for large buildings), and they can afford it (cost − quarry discount − chooser privilege).

description.zh: <worker_supply>中至少还有 1 名工人。不满足时招募官特权、<hospital>、<school>都拿不到工人。
description.en: At least 1 worker remains in the <worker_supply>. Otherwise the recruiter privilege, <hospital>, and <school> get no workers.

description.zh: <work_register>上已无工人。用于<recruiter_role>分发循环的结束边界。
description.en: No workers remain on the <work_register>. Boundary of the distribution loop in the <recruiter_role>.

description.zh: 选角者在本<craftsman_role>阶段至少生产了 1 桶货物。不满足则工匠特权作废。
description.en: The chooser produced at least 1 barrel in this <craftsman_role> phase. Otherwise the craftsman privilege is void.

description.zh: 自己<portrait>有货物，且<trading_house_slot>有空位（不满 4 桶），且所卖类型不在交易所中（有被占据的<office>则可卖已存在的类型）。
description.en: The player has a barrel on the <portrait>, the <trading_house_slot> has space (not full at 4), and the sold type is not already in the house (an occupied <office> allows selling a type already present).

description.zh: <trading_house_slot>中有 4 桶货物。此时不能再卖；<trader_role>阶段结束时若满则清空。
description.en: The <trading_house_slot> holds 4 barrels. No more sales are possible; at the end of the <trader_role> phase a full house is emptied.

description.zh: 自己<portrait>上至少 1 桶货物能合法装船：存在一艘船（空船且无其他船装该类型，或已装该类型且有剩余空间）。成立即强制装船。
description.en: At least 1 barrel on the player's <portrait> can be legally loaded: some ship exists (an empty ship whose type is on no other ship, or a ship already carrying that type with space left). When true, loading is mandatory.

description.zh: 所有玩家都不满足<can_ship_goods>。用于<captain_role>装船循环的结束边界——此后进入留存结算。
description.en: No player satisfies <can_ship_goods>. Boundary of the loading loop in the <captain_role> — storage cleanup follows.

description.zh: 选角者在本<captain_role>阶段至少装了 1 桶（普通货船或包租船）。满足则船长特权 +1 VP。
description.en: The chooser loaded at least 1 barrel this <captain_role> phase (cargo ship or chartered ship). When true, the captain privilege grants +1 VP.

name.zh: 工人不足以补充登记册

description.zh: 终局条件之一：<recruiter_role>阶段结束补充<work_register>时，<worker_supply>中的工人不够补充（登记册只得到剩余部分）。回合结束时游戏结束。
description.en: One of the endgame conditions: at the end of the <recruiter_role> phase, the <worker_supply> holds too few workers to fully repopulate the <work_register> (the register gets only what remains). The game ends at the end of the round.

description.zh: 终局条件之一：一名或多名玩家在<builder_role>阶段建满自己<city>的全部 12 格。回合结束时游戏结束。
description.en: One of the endgame conditions: one or more players filled all 12 spaces of their <city> during the <builder_role> phase. The game ends at the end of the round.

name.zh: 最后一枚 VP 筹码被拿

description.zh: 终局条件之一：<captain_role>阶段拿走了<vp_supply>中最后一枚 VP 筹码（之后用纸笔记录 VP）。回合结束时游戏结束。
description.en: One of the endgame conditions: the last VP chip is taken from the <vp_supply> during the <captain_role> phase (VP are then tracked on paper). The game ends at the end of the round.

description.zh: 波多黎各的终局条件（复合）：<not_enough_workers_to_repopulate>、<city_filled_12>、<last_vp_chip_taken>三者任一在回合内发生，本回合打完即结束游戏进入终局计分。与<most_vp_wins>分工：本条件回答「何时结束」，<most_vp_wins>回答「谁赢」。
description.en: Puerto Rico's endgame condition (compound): if any of <not_enough_workers_to_repopulate>, <city_filled_12>, or <last_vp_chip_taken> occurs during a round, the round is played out and the game ends, entering final scoring. Division of labor with <most_vp_wins>: this answers 'when it ends', <most_vp_wins> answers 'who wins'.

description.zh: 复合条件参数：{ "op": "or", "operands": ["<not_enough_workers_to_repopulate>", "<city_filled_12>", "<last_vp_chip_taken>"] }。程序据此构造复合 evaluator。
description.en: Compound condition parameters: { "op": "or", "operands": ["<not_enough_workers_to_repopulate>", "<city_filled_12>", "<last_vp_chip_taken>"] }. The program builds a compound evaluator from this.

description.zh: 该<ontology::player>的 VP 总数为全场最高——VP 总数 = VP 筹码（含纸笔记录）+ 建筑 VP（无论是否被占据）+ 被占据大建筑的加成 VP。允许并列。用于<most_vp_wins>的第 1 条判定。
description.en: The <ontology::player>'s total VP is the highest — total VP = VP chips (plus paper) + building VP (occupied or not) + bonus VP of occupied large buildings. Ties allowed. First criterion of <most_vp_wins>.

description.zh: 该<ontology::player>的钱币数与货物桶数之和为全场最多（每枚钱币或每桶货物各计 1）。允许并列。用于<most_vp_wins>的第 2 条判定（总分并列时）。
description.en: The <ontology::player>'s coins plus goods barrels total the most (each coin or barrel counts 1). Ties allowed. Second criterion of <most_vp_wins> (when total VP are tied).

description.zh: 波多黎各的胜利条件：终局计分后，按顺序满足以下条件的<ontology::player>（们）是胜者——1. VP 总数最高（筹码 + 建筑 VP + 大建筑加成）；2. 钱币与货物之和最多（平局决胜）。
description.en: Puerto Rico's victory condition: after final scoring, the <ontology::player>(s) satisfying the criteria in order win — 1. highest total VP (chips + building VP + large-building bonuses); 2. most coins and goods combined (tiebreaker).
